title: Graphic Designer, Social and Web Panels (AI-Fluent, 30 hrs/week)
description:
Graphic Designer, Social and Web Panels (AI-Fluent, 30 hrs/week)

Type of work: Part to Full Time

Wage: $650 to $900 USD per month

Hours per week: 30 to start



Job description



If this job isn’t for you, check us 
 on all socials. We’re making history.



About HeartStamp

HeartStamp is the greeting card and invitation brand built for right now. Our assistant Stampy gives people creative designer superpowers, so anyone can send a card that looks like they tried harder, cared more, and nailed it. We make professionally printed cards, HeartStamp digital cards and invitations, sold through our website and iOS app.



Our voice is witty, stylish and culturally fluent, savage-funny and emotionally real. Our visuals have to match: bold, modern, internet-native, never bland.



The role

We need a fast, hands-on graphic designer who lives in the work. You will produce our marketing visuals from start to finish: homepage hero panels, category and promo panels for web and iOS, and a steady stream of social graphics. You will work from an established brand book and a library of finished work, and your job is to extend that look at much higher speed.



This is a maker role, not a strategy seat. Speed with taste is the whole job.



The look

Our homepage hero panels look like product photography. Real printed cards, often personalized with family and friend photos, are staged with props that tell the story: envelopes, wax seals, seasonal details, the HeartStamp app in hand. We have two looks: a clean, light editorial set and a dark, moody set. Both always leave room on the left for the headline. Some panels are still images and some are short motion loops. If your portfolio has product staging, photo card mockups, lifestyle composites or ecommerce hero banners, lead with them.



What you’ll make



-Homepage hero panels, marketing panels, category banners and promo cards for 
 and our iOS app

-Static social posts and carousels for Instagram,
, Pinterest, TikTok and X

-Pinterest graphics built for search and discovery

-Short-form video for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, produced with our in-house Claude skills, then finished and polished in CapCut

-Seasonal campaign sets for our Q4 peak (Christmas, New Year, Valentine’s Day)



How we work

We are an AI-first creative shop. We built our own Claude skills that turn a brief into hero panels and short videos, and we generate imagery with Gen image models. You won’t hand-build everything from scratch. You will run these tools, direct them with sharp prompts, judge what’s good and finish it to a professional standard. If AI is already part of your daily design process, you’ll fly here. If you resist it, this isn’t the right fit.



What we’re looking for



-A strong portfolio of social and web marketing work. Framer, Behance or Dribbble preferred. Bare Google Drive folders will not be reviewed.

-3+ years of professional graphic design, ideally for consumer brands, ecommerce or social-first agencies

-Real fluency in Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma

-Photo card and product mockups: you can drop a customer photo into a card design and make the printed card look real in a styled scene, with believable light, shadow and paper texture

-CapCut video editing (required, not a bonus)

-Daily hands-on use of AI image and video tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or similar. Show us AI-assisted work in your portfolio.

-High output: multiple finished pieces a day without quality slipping

-Strong American pop-culture fluency and a sharp eye for modern design

-C1 English, written and spoken

-Reliable internet, backup power and a private workspace



Schedule



-30 hours per week, remote

-Core overlap: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM ET (9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Manila). The remaining 10 hours are flexible.

Immediate start required



Compensation

$650 to $1000 USD per month for 30 hours a week (about 130 hours a month). Paid hourly based on experience and test results, invoiced monthly and paid via Wise.



How we start

Everyone does a short paid test first. We send you one of our card designs, a sample panel and our hero spec. You build a desktop hero panel for Christmas family photo cards, plus a mobile crop and two social cut-downs. It’s paid at your quoted hourly rate with a time cap. Top candidates may be invited to a paid 2-day trial. We hire on the work.



How to apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph.

 
 with a subject line that starts with STAMPY HERO, and include:

-Your portfolio link

Your hourly rate in USD

One product or lifestyle composite you made, and how you built it

One piece you made with AI tools, and which tools you used



Applications without a portfolio or the subject keyword will not be reviewed.. Looking to hire by Oct 23, 2026. Reviewing applications as they come. Blow us away with your talent and you have a great road ahead with HeartStamp.

title: Media Buyer (Lead Generation | Performance-Focused)
description:
This role is posted by TRES on behalf of Restive Collective, one of the agencies we support. You’ll be hired by and work directly with the Restive Collective team.



About Restive Collective

Restive Collective is a Singapore-based agency that uses personal branding for lead generation. We work with founder-led, service-based businesses — coaches, consultants, gym owners and other experts — and turn their real stories into short-form video and carousel content that brings in qualified leads, not just views.



Our funnels are deliberately simple and proven: short-form video content → Meta ads → lead form or WhatsApp automation / landing page → booked conversation. Every client is spending real money every month, and your job is to make that money work.



Why This Role Is Different

This is not a branding or “boost post” role.



You’ll be working on:

Real lead-generation campaigns for real founders

Ad accounts with live monthly spend, reported and optimised daily

A tight, repeatable funnel where your decisions directly change lead volume and cost per lead

You’ll follow clear SOPs — and you’ll also be trusted to make judgment calls when the numbers call for it.

If you want to become a senior buyer who owns performance end-to-end, this role will stretch you in the right way.



What You’ll Do

Run and optimise conversion-focused Meta campaigns 
 & Instagram) across our client portfolio

Follow the daily media-buying routine: morning — check numbers, queue new ads, log and report; afternoon — optimise, analyse what’s working, recommend next moves

Own campaign health — monitor performance, flag issues early and escalate opportunities to the founder

Set up new client ad accounts (one-time setup per client) and launch new creative batches as they come from our script and video team

Support simple funnel setup where needed — landing page, VSL page and WhatsApp automation (we have a ready framework; no complex builds)

Participate in occasional weekend number-reporting for urgent, higher-spend campaigns (numbers only, with advance heads-up — not full optimisation)

You’ll receive priorities and inputs directly from the founder and account manager — no stakeholder chaos. Our VA handles the admin so you can stay on performance.



What You Will NOT Be Responsible For

Writing scripts or designing creatives (we have a scriptwriter, video editor and carousel designer)

Client communication or account management

Redesigning offers or pricing

Juggling 50–100 accounts — we are a high-value, low-volume agency and will add buyers before overloading you

Your focus is campaign performance and health, with clear boundaries and structure.

Who This Role Is For

This role is a good fit if you:

Have hands-on experience running conversion ads (leads or sales) on Meta — not branding or awareness

Think in cost per lead, CPC, CTR and ROAS, and can explain why you scale, pause or kill an ad

Stay calm, analytical and accountable when things move fast

Respect structure but don’t freeze when conditions change

Communicate clearly, report proactively and take ownership seriously

Are ready to commit full-time to one team and grow with it



Who This Role Is NOT For

“Set-and-forget” ad managers who report once a week

Freelancers juggling multiple clients or running their own agency on the side

People who only want to run brand awareness or big-budget branding campaigns

Anyone uncomfortable with responsibility tied to real client spend



How We Work

At Restive Collective, you are judged on results delivered, not hours clocked.

Results-driven \u2014 what matters is your campaigns\u2019 numbers \u2014 cost per lead, lead volume and campaign health \u2014 and how proactively you report and act on them

Systems-led \u2014 clear SOPs, an account manager and a VA so you can focus on your actual craft

Small, focused team \u2014 you work directly with the founder, not through layers of management



Compensation & Growth

SGD 800 – 1,200 / month, depending on experience

Clear SOPs, an account manager and a VA supporting you so you can focus on performance

A growth path to Senior Media Buyer — as we add clients you’ll mentor the next buyer, help build our media-buying SOPs and shape how the agency scales

Exposure to funnels, WhatsApp automation and landing pages — grow beyond ads into full-funnel thinking

If you’re looking for a comfortable, low-pressure role, this isn’t it.

If you’re looking to own performance and grow with a young agency, you’ll thrive here.



How to Apply

Please complete the application form carefully. The questions are designed to understand how you think, not just what tools you’ve used.



👉 Apply here: 
 



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.







Final Note

We’re not looking for button-pushers.

We’re looking for a media buyer who:

Respects structure

Protects campaign performance

Takes ownership seriously

If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you

title: Shopify Specialist (Theme & Page Builder)
description:
Dear Applicants,



Shopify Specialist (Theme & Page Builder) – We're Hiring!



Our product team plans every page: the idea, which sections go where, and the copy. You bring it to life on our Shopify store as a clean, polished page that works beautifully on every screen. If you have years of Shopify experience, a sharp eye for detail, and enjoy using AI tools to work faster, this role is for you.



IMPORTANT: We value responsible, self-motivated people who take ownership of their work and can deliver quality work with minimal supervision.



Job Scope:

 • Build and update pages on our Shopify store (product, collection, landing and campaign pages) from briefs prepared by our product team

 • Customise our existing theme (sections, blocks and templates) and work with page builder apps such as GemPages, PageFly or Shogun

 • Make every page look polished and on-brand: consistent spacing, alignment, font sizes, colours and image quality

 • Create or adapt simple visuals (banners, section images) using AI tools and our in-house design guidelines, and judge whether the result looks right before using it

 • Use AI coding tools (such as Codex or Claude) to speed up builds, and check and test everything they produce before it goes live

 • Test every page before publishing: mobile layout, loading speed, links, and that it matches the brief

 • Flag layout or usability problems early and suggest simple fixes, for example content that will not work well on a phone

 • Update pages for launches, promotions and seasonal campaigns



You should have:

 • At least 4 years of hands-on Shopify experience building and improving store pages

 • Confidence editing Liquid and CSS within an existing theme (adjusting sections, adding settings, fixing layouts). You will customise our theme, not build themes or apps from scratch

 • Experience with at least one page builder app (GemPages, PageFly, Shogun or similar)

 • Evidence of improving a page's conversion or performance, with the before and after to show for it

 • A strong eye for visual detail: you notice when spacing is off, text is too small, images look stretched or a page feels cluttered

 • Good UI/UX awareness: you know what makes a page easy to use on a phone, and how to fix it when it is not

 • Comfort using AI tools to create visuals and write or edit code, and checking their output carefully



You do not need to be a graphic designer. Visuals can be created with AI tools using our design guidelines. What matters most is your eye for detail and your sense of what makes a page look good and sell well.



Note:

 • Full-time basis, 40 hrs/week

 • Monday to Friday

 • 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holidays Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included



IMPORTANT: When applying, please provide:

 • Your CV/Resume

 • A short video introduction of yourself and why you think you're a good fit

 • Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application

 • Links to 2 to 3 Shopify pages you built or improved (live links preferred), with a short note on what you did for each. If you improved a page's conversion or speed, share the before and after



Applications without the above points will be less considered.



P.S. Please format your replies in point form according to the items asked above, e.g.:

 My resume is here:

 Video introduction here:

 I am currently doing... / I am leaving because...

 Here are links to Shopify pages I have built or improved...



The more information you provide in your initial application, the better.





Best regards,

 Loo Yi

title: Influencer Marketing Executive
description:
We are a baby and maternity brand with customers based in the USA, Canada, and Europe. We are a young and dynamic growing E-commerce company, looking for someone who is experienced, organized, reliable, and in it for the long run. If you are looking for a challenging, rewarding, and fulfilling career, we welcome you to apply for the job below.



Our working hour is from Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm GMT+8.



Job Overview:

We are seeking an Influencer Marketing Specialist to identify, engage, and build relationships with influencers who align with our brand. You will manage influencer outreach, oversee campaign deliverables, and track performance to drive impactful collaborations. The ideal candidate has 1–2 years of experience and a strong understanding of influencer marketing.



Job Description:

• Identify Influencers: Research and create a list of 30–50 influencers each week who align with our brand and niche, following our established influencer criteria

• Outreach and Communication: Initiate contact with influencers via
 templates, influencer management tools, or social media inboxes. Maintain regular and professional communication by addressing their inquiries, coordinating product shipments for product-for-post collaborations, and ensuring timely follow-ups

• Campaign Management: Oversee collaborations by tracking influencer deliverables, verifying that posts meet campaign requirements, and building long-term relationships with influencers

• Performance Tracking: Monitor influencer content and campaign performance, and provide feedback to refine our influencer marketing strategies

• Collaboration Coordination: Work closely with the marketing team to align influencer campaigns with broader social media, brand, and promotional objectives



Requirements:

• Experience: At least 1–2 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media management, or a related role. Experience with influencer management tools is a plus

• Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills to build and maintain professional relationships with influencers and collaborators

• Organisational Skills: Ability to manage multiple influencer campaigns simultaneously while ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met

• Social Media Knowledge: Familiarity with major social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) and an understanding of their audiences and content styles

• Analytical Mindset: Experience in tracking campaign performance metrics, analysing influencer, and reporting insights to the team

• Creativity: A keen eye for content quality and creativity to identify influencers who align with the brand’s tone and aesthetic

• Team Player: A collaborative attitude and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams

• Tech Savvy: Proficiency in tools like Google Workspace, Excel, and influencer management platforms

• Attention to Detail: High attention to detail in managing communication, contracts, and content deliverables.

• Proactivity: A self-starter with the ability to take initiative, solve problems, and adapt to a fast-paced environment



Salary:

USD400 to USD600/month



Take note of the following:

1. Title your message: "I want to join KeaBabies as an Influencer Marketing Executive"

2. Share with us your experience with Influencer Marketing .

3. No moonlighting is allowed during work hours in this role.

title: German-Speaking B2B Telephone Sales Representative – Funeral Industry
description:
HerdenkSamen Europe is looking for a fluent German-speaking B2B telephone sales professional to build relationships with funeral homes and funeral directors in German-speaking markets. We offer a digital remembrance platform and are expanding our partnerships across Europe. You will work directly with our founder in the Netherlands.



This is business-to-business sales. You will contact funeral businesses and professional decision-makers, not grieving families. This industry requires sensitivity, trust, and a calm, respectful approach.



What you will do

- Research and qualify funeral homes and other relevant B2B partners.

- Call owners and decision-makers in German, explain the offering clearly, and discover their needs.

- Book qualified demos or sales meetings and follow up consistently.

- Keep accurate notes, next steps, and outcomes in our CRM.

- Improve your call approach using feedback and measured results.

- Work independently while communicating clearly with the founder.



You should have

- Fluent spoken German suitable for professional telephone sales (C1/C2 or equivalent). Strong written German is also required.

- Proven B2B outbound telephone sales, appointment setting, or closing experience, with concrete examples and results.

- A natural, empathetic speaking style and excellent listening skills.

- Experience speaking with business owners or senior decision-makers.

- Reliable follow-up, CRM discipline, and comfort working remotely.

- Enough English to communicate with our team.

- Availability during German-speaking European business hours.



Experience in funeral services, memorial products, or B2B SaaS is useful, but proven German-language telephone selling matters most. We value quality conversations and genuine fit over call volume or aggressive scripts.



This is a full-time remote role, approximately 40 hours per week, with substantial overlap with 09:00–17:00 Netherlands time. Starting pay: $5 per hour.



How to apply

Start your application with: I SELL IN GERMAN. Then answer briefly:

title: Senior Customer Support & AI Operations Lead
description:
About the Role



We are a fast-growing consumer brand building a next-generation, AI-powered customer service operation, and we are looking for a senior Customer Support & AI Operations Lead who has been there and done it. As the company grows, the role will expand into retail customer support and operations.



Work Structure & Requirements



Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (40 hours per week, 1-hour unpaid break)

Location: Remote

Timezone: Pacific Standard Time (PST)

Start Date: Within 2 weeks

Compensation: 10 USD per hour

Own the customer support inbox and escalations as the company’s customer support lead

Clear overnight tickets the AI could not resolve at the start of each day

Process returns, refunds, and replacements accurately and promptly

Identify sensitive, complex, or unusual cases and handle or escalate them appropriately

Ensure every customer concern is documented and followed through to resolution

AI Customer Service Ownership

Own the day-to-day performance of our AI customer service agent (Siena AI)

Review AI-handled conversations, identify inaccurate or weak responses, and find the root cause

Build and refine the knowledge base, intent routing, rules, and response guidelines

Test changes in the sandbox before they go live and monitor outcomes afterwards

Run ongoing quality checks on AI responses and d
 when the AI should handle a case and when a person should step in

Escalate technical or system-level issues when additional support is needed

Building the Support Function

Design, document, and maintain SOPs for the full support operation

Improve processes and use automation to reduce manual workload

Track and report key support metrics such as response time, resolution rate, and AI resolution rate

Deliver regular voice-of-customer reporting, turning ticket patterns into product and business insights

Work closely with leadership on day-to-day operations and longer-term support strategy

Growth Scope (Next 3 to 6 Months)

Expand into retail customer support as the company grows its retail presence

Support EDI and order management alongside the operations team as needed



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 5+ years in customer support, customer experience, or support operations, including a lead role or ownership of a support function

AI Customer Service (Required): Proven hands-on experience building, or playing a major role in building, an AI-powered customer service operation, including knowledge base building, intent routing, prompt and response refinement, sandbox testing, and quality checks on AI responses

Help Desk Platforms: Strong experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, or similar; Siena AI experience is a major plus

Process & Reporting: Track record of writing SOPs and reporting on support metrics and customer insights

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; professional, empathetic, and customer-focused

Working Style: Strategic and analytical self-starter who takes ownership from identifying a problem to resolving it, and who can build a support department rather than just respond to tickets

title: Short-Form Video Editor / Content Repurposing Specialist (Retainer-Based)
description:
Job Overview:



We are a fast-growing digital agency based in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, specializing in helping local luxury real estate teams and boutique businesses scale their social media presence. We are looking for a creative, highly reliable, long-term Video Editor to join our team behind the scenes.

Your role is to take raw concept assets (scripts, stock footage, or unedited clips) and turn them into premium, high-retention 9:16 vertical videos.



Core Responsibilities (Job to be Done):



• Video Editing & Pacing: Cut down raw footage into highly engaging 15-to-60-second vertical videos (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts). Trim out awkward pauses, dead air, and filler words.

• Dynamic Subtitles: Generate and style clean, kinetic on-screen captions. Text must be perfectly synced with the pacing and feature high-end, premium fonts that align with a luxury brand identity.

• Visual Enhancements: Apply clean transitions, color correction, and intentional zoom cuts/punches to maintain viewer attention every 2 to 3 seconds.

• Audio Design: Source and layer trending, royalty-free background music and subtle sound effects (risers, swooshes, clicks) to maximize impact.

• Caption & Queue Management: Write a short, optimized caption for each video and schedule the finalized assets inside our social media pipeline (Metricool/Publer).



Compensation & Work Structure:



• This is a retainer-based, part-time position that scales with your output.

• We pay a flat retainer of $250 to $350 USD per month, per client account you manage.

• Each client account requires a consistent delivery of 12 to 15 completed vertical videos per month.

• As we sign more clients, you will be handed more accounts to manage, allowing your monthly income to scale proportionally (e.g., 4 accounts = $1,000 to $1,400/mo).



Application Instructions (Mandatory Test Edit):



To be considered for this position, you must complete a quick 15-second test edit using the exact real estate script provided below. You are free to use any high-definition, royalty-free luxury home tour footage, stock clips, and background music you choose.

The Test Script:

• Hook Text (0–3s): "Inside a $3,500,000 Modern Mansion in Southlake, Texas..."

• Body Text (3–12s): "Featuring a private chef's kitchen, custom floor-to-ceiling glass windows, and a resort-style infinity pool."

• Call to Action (12–15s): "Looking to move to DFW? Click the link in our bio to view the private listing."

Applications submitted without a link to a completed 15-second video matching this exact script will be automatically ignored.

title: Finance Manager (Daily Reporting)
description:
Full time, 40 hours a week, spread across 7 days. Remote, based in the Philippines. Reports to the CEO.



We are a 24/7 business. That is why the week is 7 days and not 5. The hours are normal, the rhythm is not.

We are a two entity, two market, inventory heavy DTC beauty business running on Shopify and Amazon with China direct and 3PL fulfilment. Revenue is not our problem. Visibility is.



We need a qualified accountant who turns a messy, cross border operation into a small set of numbers we can look at every single day and trust. Not a month end role. Not a board deck role. A daily discipline role.



The rhythm is the point: a report lands every morning, seven days a week, including weekends and holidays. We spend money on ads every day, so we need to see profit and cash every day. Weekends are when problems hide.

The Philippines time zone is a deliberate advantage here. You work your morning, the previous European day has just closed, and your pack is in Slack before Amsterdam opens.



You will work alongside our existing external accounting partners (a US accounting firm, Dutch bookkeepers and a cross border accountant) rather than replacing them. They handle statutory and compliance. You own management reporting.



The daily rhythm

Every day, 7 days a week, delivered by 13:00 PHT (around 07:00 CET):

• Cash position across all bank accounts and both entities

• Yesterday’s revenue, gross profit and ad spend by market and channel

• Blended MER and contribution margin after ad spend

• Refunds, chargebacks and payment provider reserve movements

• Any red flag, called out in one line at the top

Weekend versions can be a lighter, largely templated snapshot, but they land.

Every Monday:

• Full management P&L for the prior week

• Contribution margin by SKU, channel and market

• Inventory position and stock cover in weeks

• Rolling 13 week cash flow forecast, updated

• KPI pack for the founding team

Every month:

• Consolidated cross border P&L (NL and US) and balance sheet review

• Variance against plan, with commentary on the why

• Reconciliation sign off across Shopify, Amazon, payment providers, 3PL and the ledger

What You’ll Own Beyond the Reporting

• Cash forecasting: the rolling 13 week forecast, including inventory and purchase order cash planning against production lead times

• Unit economics: true landed COGS per SKU (freight, duty, fulfilment), and contribution margin by SKU, channel, market and cohort

• Channel P&Ls: Shopify DACH, Shopify US, Amazon US, comparable and reconciled

• Payment risk monitoring: reserves, rolling reserves and chargeback exposure

• FX exposure across EUR, USD and PHP

• Invoice verification: supplier and 3PL invoices checked against contracted terms

• Automation: templates, defined metrics, connected data sources. If the daily pack takes two hours by month three, something is wrong



What We’re Looking For

• Philippine CPA, or an equivalent qualification with a strong practical track record

• 4+ years in accounting or finance, including hands on management reporting

• Ecommerce or inventory based business experience

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. You have built cash flow models yourself

• Comfortable reconciling data from Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, payment gateways and 3PL reports

• Multi currency and multi entity experience

• Reliable to a fault. A pack that lands 6 days out of 7 is worth a fraction of one that lands 7

• Willing to work a 7 day rhythm with light weekend days, and to cover Philippine public holidays

• Excellent written English and the confidence to tell a CEO a number he will not like

Strong Plus

• Beauty, cosmetics or CPG experience

• Experience reporting for a Western or European company from the Philippines

• BI or automation skills (Looker Studio, Power BI, SQL, Zapier or similar)

• Familiarity with NL and US cross border reporting

• Xero, QuickBooks or a comparable cloud ledger



First 90 Days Looks Like Success If

1. The daily pack has landed every day for 30 consecutive days and leadership trusts it

2. A 13 week rolling cash forecast is live, updated weekly, and reliable enough to make decisions on

3. True landed COGS and contribution margin are known per SKU and per channel

4. The daily pack takes under 45 minutes to produce because the rest is automated



What We Offer

• Fully remote, permanently

• Direct access to the CEO

• Genuine ownership of the finance function as it grows

• HMO health coverage and 13th month pay

• Paid monthly via Wise



What to Include in Your Application

• Your CPA registration number, or the equivalent qualification with the body that issued it

• One management report you built yourself, redacted as needed, so we can see the format and the metrics you chose

• The names of the systems you have reconciled across, and for which business

• Confirmation in writing that you are available on a 7 day rhythm

description:
We are a fast growing DTC skincare brand running around €2.4M a month in ad spend across the US and DACH. Today Google and Pinterest sit with external agencies. We want them in house. We are looking for a Head of Paid Media to own every paid channel we run and to take that work back from the agencies.



Full time. Owns all paid channels and the people on them. Reports to the founders. Compensation reflects the level of experience we are asking for.



What You’ll Do

• Own paid media across Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, Pinterest and native.

• Bring the agency channels in house. Google and Pinterest are run externally today. Your job is to run them yourself or with your own buyers, at the same or better result.

• Launch, scale and pause within agreed budgets, on your own call. We should not have to tell you what to do.

What We’re Looking For

• Meta: you have personally run at least €2M to €2.5M a month. €2.5M to €3M is better. This is the first thing we check.

• Google: at least €500K a month. Not advised on, not overseen. Run.

• Real experience on TikTok, AppLovin and native, enough to lead those channels rather than learn them on our budget.

• You have taken a channel off an agency and run it in house before, or you can explain exactly how you would.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
We are a fast growing DTC skincare brand selling in 8 countries, producing direct with manufacturers in China and fulfilling through a 3PL and Amazon FBA. We are looking for a Supply Chain Manager to own everything from the factory to the warehouse shelf.



Full time. Owns production, inbound logistics, stock planning and Amazon inbound. Reports to the COO.



What You Own

-The suppliers. You are the single point of contact with our manufacturers in China. Pricing, production orders, cargo ready dates, and pushing for a partial shipment when we need stock sooner. You come back with a date, not with a promise to check.

-The stock. You know our stock level per SKU per market without being asked, and you reorder before anything runs out. If a SKU will go out of stock inside its own lead time, we hear it from you first. You also keep the 3PL inventory records right, per SKU code, and you flag it when their numbers and ours do not agree.

-Quality control. You agree the inspection date with the supplier, coordinate with our QC firm, and get the inspection booked in time to cover a meaningful part of the order rather than the last carton.

-Barcodes and labelling. The right barcode on the right product, checked on the line before production runs. A wrong barcode caught after 50,000 units are sealed is a failure of this role.

-Compliance and documentation. Lab testing for each market, certification, ingredient and claim documents, UPC registration, and checking packaging artwork before it goes to print.

-Inbound logistics. Freight quotes and bookings, sea and air, carton and pallet planning, customs and duty, and delivery into our 3PL.

-Amazon inbound. FBA shipment plans with our 3PL, relabelling instructions, cartonization, and getting goods dispatched into the Amazon warehouse.

-New product production. From sample through to first shipment.

-Supplier invoices. You prepare and submit them with the matching order so finance can verify and pay. You do not pay them yourself.

-Reporting. Stock cover per SKU, landed cost per SKU to finance, every open production order with its date, and anything at risk, once a week without being asked.



What You Do Not Own

This is here so there is no confusion about it later.

• Individual customer orders. Ready for pickup lists, failed deliveries, returns to sender, reshipments, refunds and fraud risk orders sit with the backend order team.

• Customer service and disputes.

• Paying invoices. You prepare, finance pays.

• The Amazon account itself. Listings, pricing, advertising and account health sit elsewhere. You own what physically goes into the warehouse.

How the Role Is Judged

• Nothing sits still without us knowing it is sitting. If you are waiting on a decision, a sample or a supplier, you say so the same day.

• No stockout that was visible in advance. Lead times are known, so running out is a planning failure, not bad luck.

• You raise the problem before it reaches us from the 3PL or from a customer.

• You do not need to be chased for an update.

What We’re Looking For

• You have run production directly with manufacturers in China, not through an agent or a trading company.

• You have placed and tracked purchase orders against lead times for a physical product business, with stock cover as the number you were judged on.

• You have shipped into Amazon FBA yourself: barcodes, labelling, cartonization, inbound placement.

• Cosmetics or another regulated category, so certification, claims and ingredient documents are not new to you.

• Freight experience: quotes, bookings, customs and duty, sea and air.

• You overlap with both China and Europe in your working day.

• Full time. This role failed before as a part time arrangement and we are not repeating that.

• You work ahead of the problem rather than reacting to it.



What to Include in Your Application

• The products you ran production for, the supplier country, and the volume per month or per year.

• One FBA shipment you planned, with the units and the carton count.

• A stockout you caused or inherited, and what you changed afterwards.

• One time you pushed a supplier into a date they said was impossible, and how.

• Your time zone and your working hours.

title: Agency Project Manager (ClickUp Focus)- Remote Philippines
description:
We are a Sydney-based creative agency looking for a highly organised Agency Project Manager to coordinate delivery across client service, creative, social, influencer, digital and production.



This role is for someone who can create order quickly and keep work moving. You will turn briefs, meetings and conversations into clear project plans, follow actions through to completion and make sure the team knows what is due, what is missing, what is blocked and what needs a decision.



You will own the day-to-day coordination of agreed projects, from brief and kickoff through to delivery and wrap-up. Success means reliable project visibility, fewer missed handovers and less chasing by senior team members.



You will work closely with our Head of Client Service & Operations, Senior Account Directors and creative team. The Head of Client Service & Operations will be your primary escalation point for competing priorities and delivery issues. Account leads will retain responsibility for client relationships, strategy and commercial decisions, and creative leads will retain responsibility for creative quality and approval.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Build and manage ClickUp project plans from agreed briefs, with clear deliverables, named owners, realistic deadlines, milestones, dependencies and approval steps.

- Check that briefs and handovers contain the information needed to start work, and follow up on missing information before it causes delays.

- Keep ClickUp as the agreed source of delivery status. Capture actions and decisions from Slack, meetings and campaign documents, with links to the relevant files.

- Prepare and coordinate internal work-in-progress meetings, record decisions and follow actions through to completion.

- Follow up professionally and persistently with team members, including senior staff, on agreed commitments.

- Track assets, feedback, revisions and approvals. Check that deliverables are complete, use the correct versions and specifications, and have the required approvals recorded.

- Coordinate handovers between account service, creative, social, influencer, digital, production and external suppliers where required.

- Identify competing deadlines and check team availability before confirming timings. Flag capacity constraints to the operations lead.

- Flag scope changes, extra deliverables and additional revision rounds to the account lead before they become unplanned work.

- Escalate risks and blockers early, explaining the impact, the decision needed and your recommended next step.

- Prepare concise weekly status updates showing milestones, owners, risks and decisions required. Escalate urgent issues as they arise.

- Coordinate launch-readiness checks and post-campaign wrap-up, including final assets, outstanding actions and handover to reporting or finance owners.

- Improve practical ClickUp templates, views, dashboards and workflows so they are consistent and useful for the team.



ABOUT YOU



- You have experience managing multiple projects in a creative agency, marketing team or similar delivery environment.

- You can turn messy information into a clear, workable plan and keep that plan current.

- You are proactive and comfortable asking questions, following up with senior people and escalating problems respectfully.

- You understand campaign timelines, creative production, approvals, dependencies and handovers.

- You can distinguish a status update from a problem that needs a decision, and suggest a practical next step.

- You have hands-on ClickUp experience, including setting up and maintaining project plans, templates, views or dashboards.

- You write clearly and professionally in English and have strong attention to detail without becoming slow.

- You can work independently while staying closely connected to an Australian team.



TOOLS



ClickUp, Slack and Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Slides.



Familiarity with Canva or Adobe production workflows is useful but not essential.



The focus of this role is project coordination and delivery. Specialist team members will handle paid media buying, social media management, creator sourcing, design and strategy.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Remote role based in the Philippines.

- Full-time, 38 hours per week.

- USD $1,300-$1,900 per month, depending on experience.

- Regular weekday overlap with Australia/Sydney business hours is required. A consistent working schedule will be agreed before starting, taking Sydney daylight saving into account.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:

1. A brief example of a campaign or project that started slipping: what was going wrong, what you personally did and what happened.

2. An example of a ClickUp project plan, template, view, dashboard or workflow you have built or improved. You can describe it or share an anonymised screenshot; please do not share confidential client information.

3. Your availability, earliest start date and the hours you can overlap with Australia/Sydney.



Applications that do not address these points will not be reviewed.

title: Experienced Amazon Wholesale Product Researcher / Catalog Analyst — Exclusive Role
description:
Amazon Wholesale Product Researcher — Part Time



Pay: $3–7 USD/hour based on demonstrated skills, plus performance bonuses.

Hours: Initially 10 hours/week, with potential to increase.

Location: Remote, Philippines.



ABOUT JKB WHOLESALE



JKB Wholesale is a Texas-based business sourcing wholesale products for resale on Amazon in the United States. We’re looking for one experienced researcher to help evaluate supplier catalogs and build a reliable product-selection process.



We value accurate research, honest communication and a respectful working relationship. This position has potential to become an ongoing role as our business grows.



THE ROLE



Your initial focus will be analyzing supplier price lists and maintaining a clear research spreadsheet. You should already understand Amazon wholesale research. We will provide onboarding to our specific criteria, reporting format and approval process.



Main responsibilities:

• Match supplier products to Amazon listings, verifying UPC, size, variation, pack count and case quantities.

• Review Keepa price history, estimated demand, Buy Box competition and Amazon presence.

• Calculate FBA and FBM profitability, including relevant product, shipping, prep and Amazon costs.

• Flag supplier minimums, restrictions, expiration concerns and questions requiring verification.

• Record supporting links, calculations and clear recommendations in our research Sheet.



Accurate rejection of unsuitable products is valuable. We do not expect a guaranteed number of profitable leads.



TECHNICAL SKILLS — REQUIRED



• Relevant U.S. Amazon wholesale product-research experience.

• Strong Keepa analysis and accurate product matching.

• Understanding of FBA/FBM economics and case-to-sellable-unit calculations.

• Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, filtering and lookups.



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



• Seller Assistant, SellerAmp or similar tools.

• Bulk catalog screening and data cleanup.

• Understanding of MAP policies, brand restrictions and Amazon eligibility checks.



COMMUNICATION AND WORK HABITS



• Clear written English and attention to detail.

• Reliable progress updates and agreed deadlines.

• Willingness to ask questions, flag uncertainty and report mistakes promptly.

• Ability to work independently and explain your reasoning.

• Reliable computer and internet connection.



We welcome questions and process improvements. Research tools, access and communication times will be agreed before starting.



CONFIDENTIALITY AND EXCLUSIVITY



Our confidential supplier relationships, pricing, catalogs, curated leads and research must not be shared, sold, published or used for yourself or other clients. No subcontracting or sharing access.



Written confidentiality terms are required before private materials are provided.



The ongoing role requires exclusive commitment: no other clients, lead-selling activities or competing personal Amazon sourcing during the engagement. Compensation, guaranteed hours and the exclusive start date must be mutually agreed before this requirement begins.



All purchases and supplier commitments require owner approval.



PAY AND SELECTION



• $3–6 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated ability.

• A paid 3–5-hour assessment, with rate and payment terms agreed in advance. Assessment payment does not depend on being hired.

• Weekly payment initially.

• Performance bonuses based on criteria agreed in writing.

• Potential for increased hours, responsibilities and compensation as performance and business needs justify.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with “WHOLESALE ANALYST” and include:



1. A brief summary of your relevant experience and research tools.

2. Your requested hourly rate and weekly availability.

3. Current client commitments, any personal Amazon business or lead-selling activities, and the rate/hours you would require for exclusivity.

4. One redacted work sample you have permission to share.

5. A short explanation of how you detect pack-count mismatches and evaluate an unstable Keepa chart.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and paid assessment. Relevant references may be requested.

You will also be expected to understand current trends across **Instagram Reels, TikTok and Meta advertising**, including the visual styles and editing techniques that make content feel organic to these platforms.

- Experience creating realistic **AI UGC-style videos**

- Strong understanding of what makes AI-generated footage look authentic versus obviously artificial

- Strong understanding of Instagram, Instagram Reels and short-form social content

- Experience editing content for
, Instagram and TikTok

- Experience creating direct-response advertisements designed to generate sales

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention and storytelling

- Ability to match reference videos and recreate specific creative styles

- Strong proficiency with professional video editing software

- Experience working with modern AI video generation tools and workflows

- Ability to identify and correct unnatural AI movements, expressions, product interactions or visual inconsistencies

- Strong attention to detail

- Proficient English communication skills of at least C1 level

- Availability to work according to Australian Eastern Daylight Time (AEDT)



## What We Are Looking For



We want someone who understands that **good AI UGC should not feel like AI UGC**.



The ideal candidate has a strong eye for the small details that make content believable: camera shake, lighting, framing, pacing, facial expressions, natural pauses, imperfect movement and realistic interactions with products.



You should regularly consume content on Instagram and TikTok and have a strong understanding of what currently feels authentic on these platforms.



We value:



- Adaptability

- Fast communication

- Strong creative judgement

- Attention to detail

- Willingness to experiment with new AI tools

- Ambition to grow into a larger creative role within the company



This is a **REMOTE position**.

title: Creative Copywriter + Storyteller for Short-Form Content
description:
Creative Copywriter + Storyteller for Short-Form Content



I’m looking for a seriously good writer.



Not someone who copies a prompt into ChatGPT and sends me whatever comes back.



I run multiple content brands and produce short-form content across Instagram, TikTok,
 and YouTube. Some of our content includes cinematic AI-generated videos, but the writing behind the content needs to feel HUMAN.



Real conversations.

Real emotion.

Good storytelling.

Strong hooks.

Characters people actually care about.

Copy that makes somebody stop scrolling.



You may be writing a dramatic 60-second scene one day, a funny carousel the next, and a promotional video the next.



I need someone who understands how people actually talk and knows how to turn a simple idea into content people want to watch.



 What you'll write



You may be responsible for:



• 30–90 second short-form video scripts  

• Episodic stories and recurring characters  

• Hooks and opening lines  

• Natural dialogue  

• Cliffhangers  

• Social media captions  

• Carousel copy  

• Promotional scripts  

• Story-based sales content  

• Content concepts and angles  

• Rewriting content to match different brand voices



You should be comfortable switching voices.



One brand may be dramatic and cinematic.



Another may be funny, conversational and relatable.



Another may need persuasive copy designed to generate leads or sales.



They should NOT all sound like the same writer.



 IMPORTANT: AI usage



We use AI in our business. I am not against AI.



However, I am specifically hiring you because I need a HUMAN writer.



AI can be used as a supporting tool for research, brainstorming or editing, but it should not be doing the creative thinking and writing for you.



If your normal process is:



Prompt ChatGPT → copy → lightly edit → submit



this position is not for you!



I can already do that myself.



I am looking for someone who has their own creative instincts, understands human behavior, can develop original ideas and can write dialogue that sounds like something real people would actually say.



How we will hire...



There will be multiple rounds.



Round 1 — Application



Send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Three writing samples you're proud of.

3. Tell me what type of writing you're BEST at.

4. Tell me what type of writing you struggle with.

5. Tell me honestly how you currently use AI in your writing process.



Do NOT send me a long formal cover letter.



Round 2 — Writing test



Selected applicants will receive a short writing assignment.



You may be asked to:



• Write a short dramatic scene.

• Rewrite bad/robotic copy so it sounds human.

• Create hooks from a basic idea.

• Write the same message for two completely different audiences.



The purpose isn't perfection.



I want to see how your brain works.



 Round 3 — Live writing session



Finalists may complete a short PAID live writing session.



Room for growth is possible as we expand.

title: Real Estate SMS Manager
description:
SMS Manager (Real Estate Acquisitions, Launch Control)



We run off-market Acquisitions in the United States and are hiring an SMS Manager to own our seller text outreach end to end. You will build and load lists, launch and pace campaigns in Launch Control and/or Smarter Contact, protect deliverability, and get qualified replies to the acquisitions team fast.



What you will own



Campaigns: Build, launch, schedule, and pace campaigns in Launch Control. Manage sending numbers, rotation, and campaign naming so results stay traceable.



Reply handling: Monitor inbound replies during your shift, respond using the approved qualification script, and route qualified sellers to acquisitions immediately. You will not improvise messaging or go off script.



Lists and data: Pull property and owner records in PropStream, run skip tracing, and deliver clean, deduplicated, correctly mapped upload files. Scrub DNC and prior opt outs before every send.



Deliverability: Track delivery rates, carrier filtering, and number health. Verify spintax and merge field syntax before launch. Flag drops in delivery before they cost us send volume.



Compliance: Maintain opt out and DNC records, follow TCPA and Florida FTSA requirements, and keep 10DLC registration details accurate.



Reporting: Daily numbers on sends, delivery rate, reply rate, qualified leads, and cost per qualified lead, with a short note on what changed and why.



Testing: Run controlled tests on approved message variants, segments, and send timing. One variable at a time. Report the result.



Targets you will be measured on



Delivery rate above 90 percent

Reply response time under 5 minutes during shift hours

Qualified leads per 1,000 sends, tracked and improving month over month

Zero compliance incidents

What this role is not



No outbound calls. No appointment setting. No negotiating price with sellers. Text execution and data only.



Requirements



Hands on experience running SMS campaigns in Launch Control and Smarter Contact. This is required and will be verified in a test task.

Working experience in PropStream or a comparable data platform, including polygon and filter based list pulls.

Skip tracing experience (KindSkiptracing, BatchSkipTracing, or similar).

Strong spreadsheet and data hygiene skills: deduplication, field mapping, formatting for upload.

Understanding of SMS deliverability: carrier filtering, number health, spintax, merge fields.

Written English strong enough to handle live seller replies without sounding scripted or foreign to a US reader.

Reliable overlap with 9am to 6pm US Eastern.

CRM experience, Salesforce preferred but not required.



$4-$5/hour, with an incentive program which will be based around response rates and conversion rates.

title: HR & People Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded and people-focused HR & People Manager to lead and strengthen the people function at Cosy Hauz.



This is a strategic yet hands-on role, responsible for ensuring we have the right people, structures, processes and culture in place to support our continued growth.



Working closely with the COO, CEO and leadership team, you will take ownership of the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding to performance management, employee engagement, learning and development, and HR governance.



We are looking for someone who can think ahead, take initiative and turn ideas into action. Beyond managing HR processes, you will play a key role in shaping our workplace culture, developing our people and ensuring our company values, particularly Growth Mindset, are reflected in everything we do.



Key Responsibilities



Recruitment & Workforce Planning

- Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, from workforce planning and candidate sourcing to selection and onboarding.

- Build a strong talent pipeline aligned with the company's values and business needs.

- Work with department heads to identify staffing requirements and plan for future growth.



HR Policies, Governance & Compliance

- Develop, review and continuously improve HR policies, procedures and internal processes.

- Ensure HR practices comply with applicable employment legislation and company policies.

- Conduct regular HR audits, maintain accurate documentation and identify opportunities for improvement.



Performance Management

- Lead the company's performance appraisal and evaluation processes.

- Work with managers to establish clear performance expectations, KPIs and development objectives.

- Support performance improvement initiatives and promote accountability across teams.



Employee Engagement & Relations

- Develop and implement initiatives that improve employee engagement, satisfaction and retention.

- Manage employee relations matters with fairness, professionalism and confidentiality.

- Promote open communication and proactively address workplace concerns.



Culture & Values

- Strengthen and maintain a positive, collaborative and high-performing workplace culture.

- Embed Cosy Hauz's core values, particularly Growth Mindset, throughout the employee experience.

- Encourage continuous improvement, accountability, teamwork and professional growth.



Learning & Development

- Identify training needs and employee capability gaps.

- Develop and coordinate relevant learning, training and professional development programmes.

- Support managers in developing their teams and building leadership capabilities.



Benefits & HR Administration

- Oversee employee benefits, HR documentation and administrative processes.

- Maintain accurate, organised and confidential employee records.

- Ensure employees receive timely and effective HR support throughout their employment.



HR Reporting & Strategic Partnership

- Monitor and analyse HR metrics, including recruitment, retention, attendance, engagement and performance.

- Provide actionable insights and recommendations to support workforce efficiency and business decisions.

- Partner closely with the COO and leadership team to anticipate organisational needs and implement practical HR solutions.



Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field.

- Minimum of 3–5 years of progressive HR experience, with demonstrated ownership across multiple HR functions.

- Proven experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management, HR policies and employee engagement.

- Good understanding of employment legislation, HR compliance and organisational governance.

- Experience developing, implementing and improving HR policies and procedures.

- Experience managing performance appraisal processes, employee benefits and HR administration.

- Strong communication, interpersonal, organisational and problem-solving skills.

- Confidence in working with senior management and supporting organisational decisions.

- Proficiency in HR systems, Microsoft Office and other workplace productivity tools.



What We're Looking For

- Strategic & Commercially Minded: You understand how people decisions contribute to productivity, business performance and long-term growth.

- Proactive & Accountable: You take initiative, anticipate challenges and follow through on commitments.

- Hands-On & Resourceful: You are equally comfortable developing strategies and executing day-to-day HR responsibilities.

- People-Centred: You genuinely care about employee wellbeing, development and building a supportive workplace.

- Confident & Decisive: You exercise sound judgement, communicate clearly and are comfortable challenging ideas constructively.

- Growth-Minded: You are adaptable, open to feedback and constantly looking for ways to improve.

- Resilient & Organised: You can manage competing priorities and remain effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment.



What Success Looks Like



In this role, you will help build an HR function that is structured, proactive and aligned with the company's long-term goals.



Success means creating an environment where employees understand their expectations, managers are equipped to lead effectively, HR processes are dependable, and company values are consistently reflected in everyday decisions.



Most importantly, you will become a trusted partner to leadership, helping Cosy Hauz develop a capable, engaged and high-performing workforce.



Why Join Cosy Hauz?



At Cosy Hauz, we believe that building a successful business starts with developing great people.



You'll have the opportunity to take real ownership of the HR function, work closely with senior leadership and make a meaningful impact on how our organisation grows.



We value initiative, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. We are looking for someone who shares these values and is excited to help shape the next stage of our company's development.



If you're passionate about people, driven by continuous improvement and ready to build something meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Paid Ads Operator
description:
Run paid campaigns for a US legal growth company and its law firm clients, with AI doing the volume work and you doing the judgment. Remote, full time, independent contractor.



The Company

Who you would be working for



My Legal Academy is a tech-forward growth infrastructure company for law firms, founded in 2019 and based in Los Angeles, California. We do not sell marketing services. We install and operate complete growth systems inside small US law firms: intake, CRM, follow-up automation and paid acquisition. We have worked with more than 2,000 firms, and the metric we are judged on is signed cases, not clicks.



That distinction matters for this role. A campaign that produces cheap leads nobody signs is a failed campaign here. You will be looking at cost per signed case as often as cost per lead.



The Role

What you would own



You will manage two campaign portfolios end to end with underlying support of AI platforms. You are not handing creative to a designer and media buying to a specialist. You are the person who takes a budget, a practice area and a market, and comes back with a campaign that works.



Internal Campaigns

My Legal Academy's own lead generation: paid social driving attorneys into our programs, plus webinar and program launch campaigns. You own budget allocation, creative, targeting and the numbers we review weekly, and you build the test plans with our marketing lead.



Client Campaigns

Meta ads for law firm clients across personal injury, estate planning, immigration, family and business law. Multiple accounts at once, each with its own market, budget and partner who wants to know where the money went.



Creative Production

Creating or assisting the team with ad concepts, hooks, copy, static and video creative, and the testing plan behind them. You generate variants at volume with AI, then apply taste to decide which ones run.



Funnels and Follow-up

Landing pages, lead magnets, forms and the GoHighLevel automations behind them. A lead that reaches a CRM and gets no follow-up is a lead we paid for and lost, so the funnel is part of the campaign and part of your job.



How we measure it

For My Legal Academy: cost per qualified attorney lead, webinar registrations, calls booked with sales, CAC, ROAS.

For clients: cost per qualified lead, consultations, signed cases, ROAS.

Underperforming campaigns raised early, with a fix attached.



The Differentiator

How we work with AI



This is the part of the job that is not standard, and the part we will screen hardest on. Our team runs on Claude. Not as a novelty and not as a copywriting shortcut, but as the default way work gets done. The people who do well here have restructured how they work around it.



In practice that means you build your own tooling instead of waiting for someone to build it for you. Set up Claude Projects with your account context so you are not re-explaining a client every session. Write prompts that produce forty ad variants worth reading, not four that need rewriting. Hand a spend export to Claude and get the analysis back in minutes instead of building the pivot table yourself. Draft the client performance summary, then edit it, instead of starting from a blank page. Use ranql, our competitive intelligence platform for law firm markets, to map each market and the ads competitors run.

We are not looking for someone who has heard of AI. We are looking for someone whose current output would drop by half if you took the tools away. If that describes you, the interview will be easy and you should apply.



What you get

Ownership of paid ads for My Legal Academy and for our law firm clients.

Claude and Claude Code as your daily tools, plus access to ranql.

Direct work with the CEO, Head of Growth, marketing lead and the client success team.

Pay: $9.50 to $11.50 an hour, full time (40 hours a week), paid twice a month.



Requirements

What you need to have



Experience: Two or more years running Meta campaigns with real budget. You have managed money that was not yours and reported on it to someone who cared.

AI Fluency: Genuine daily use, particularly with Claude, including maintaining your own prompt library and knowing what these tools are bad at. You will be asked to show your work.

Creative Range: Ability to write a hook and build a static creative that stops a scroll, using AI or other no-code tools.

Data and Metrics: Comfort with CPL, CPA, ROAS and cost per signed case, and the transparency to surface underperforming campaigns promptly.

Communication: Written English strong enough for copy aimed at US attorneys and performance summaries for partners.

Availability: Full overlap with US Pacific business hours.

Setup: Reliable workstation, stable internet with a backup connection and a quiet environment for client calls.



Strong Plus

Google Ads: Search campaigns with real budget.

GoHighLevel: Builder-level experience with sub-accounts, snapshots, workflows, pipelines and calendars.

Funnel Building: Landing pages across GHL, Webflow, Framer or custom builds.

US Legal Market: Prior experience in legal lead generation, particularly personal injury.

Video Editing: CapCut, Premiere, Descript or AI-assisted video production.

Technical AI: Claude Code, MCP servers or scripting for reporting automation.

Copywriting and CRO: Background in conversion copywriting or conversion rate optimization.



Not a Fit If

We would rather you self-select out now than discover it in week three.

You require a detailed brief before you can start executing.

Your experience is strictly limited to agency roles where others handled client relationships and budget management.

You use AI tools to generate content without editing or reviewing it yourself.

You intend to negotiate away working US Pacific hours after joining.

You plan to manage this alongside another full-time position.



How to apply

Send your resume to 
 candidates join a recorded video interview. Come ready to show, from your own past work:

Two Meta campaigns you ran, with the numbers before and after (screen share or exported reports, client names hidden).

The AI workflow behind them: the prompts, Claude Projects or scripts you used for research, creative and reporting.

Ads you wrote or built, which ones won and why.

One campaign that underperformed, what told you, and what you changed.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (CapCut Expert) – Ongoing, Part-Time
description:
About Me
