title: Finance & Accounts Officer – Australian Business / Xero
description:
# Finance & Accounts Officer – Australian Business / Xero Experience



**Company:** AusGreen Energy Group Pty Ltd  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Employment:** Part-Time – 24 hours per week  

**Salary:** AUD $8–15 per hour (negotiable based on experience)



## About Us



AusGreen Energy Group is an Australian renewable energy company based in Sydney, NSW, specialising in residential and commercial solar PV systems, battery energy storage systems and electrical installations.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organised and detail-oriented **Finance & Accounts Officer** to manage our day-to-day financial administration, bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, payroll preparation, financial reporting and job profitability tracking.



The successful candidate will work closely with our Compliance & Operations Officer, company directors and external accountants to maintain accurate financial records, improve financial visibility and ensure our business operates efficiently.



**Previous experience working with Australian businesses and using Xero is strongly preferred. Experience in the Australian solar, electrical or construction industry is a significant advantage.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Customer Invoicing

- Receive accepted proposals, job numbers and payment terms from the Compliance & Operations Officer.

- Prepare and issue customer deposit, progress and final invoices at agreed milestones.

- Check correct company entity, customer details, job references and approved pricing.

- Apply the appropriate GST treatment and payment terms.

- Record approved variations and prevent duplicate invoices.

- Maintain accurate customer invoicing records in Xero.



### 2. Accounts Receivable & Customer Payments

- Monitor customer payments and outstanding balances.

- Match customer receipts to the correct invoices.

- Allocate deposits, progress payments and final payments correctly.

- Follow up overdue customer accounts.

- Provide payment status updates to the Compliance Officer for ClickUp.

- Escalate disputed invoices, refunds and payment arrangements to management.



### 3. Brighte Finance Payment Tracking

- Track approved customer finance amounts and any customer contributions.

- Record completion submission dates and expected settlement amounts.

- Monitor outstanding and completed Brighte settlements.

- Reconcile actual receipts against expected amounts.

- Follow up documentation issues with the Compliance Officer.

- Report delayed, missing or incorrect settlements.



### 4. STC Payment Tracking

- Receive STC submission references and expected payment information from the Compliance Officer.

- Track expected STC proceeds for completed installations.

- Reconcile STC receipts against settlement statements.

- Maintain accurate records of paid and outstanding claims.

- Follow up overdue or incorrect payments.

- Escalate discrepancies to management.



### 5. Supplier Bills & Accounts Payable

- Enter supplier invoices and bills into Xero.

- Attach invoices and supporting documentation.

- Allocate equipment purchases, installation materials and other costs to the appropriate accounts and jobs.

- Verify invoice amounts against agreed supplier pricing.

- Record supplier credit notes and adjustments.

- Monitor payment due dates.

- Reconcile supplier statements and identify duplicate or incorrect charges.

- Confirm quantities received with onsite staff where required.



### 6. Supplier Credit Account Management

- Maintain a register of supplier credit limits.

- Monitor balances owing and available credit.

- Track open purchase orders and committed purchases.

- Calculate remaining purchasing capacity.

- Identify overdue supplier balances.

- Follow up missing credits and invoice discrepancies.

- Notify management when credit limits are approaching or exceeded.



### 7. Installer Invoices & Payment Preparation

- Receive installation completion confirmation from the Compliance Officer.

- Review installer invoices against agreed installation rates.

- Verify approved additional works and variations.

- Check completion approval and outstanding rectifications.

- Confirm payment terms and due dates.

- Prepare installer invoices for scheduled payment.

- Submit payment schedules to management for approval.



**The Finance Officer prepares payments but does not independently approve or release bank payments.**



### 8. Payroll Administration

- Prepare payroll using approved employee timesheets.

- Verify working hours, pay rates, leave and deductions.

- Maintain employee payroll and leave records.

- Prepare payroll summaries for management approval.

- Assist with Single Touch Payroll (STP) reporting and superannuation administration within authorised responsibilities.

- Track payroll liabilities and payment deadlines.

- Refer payroll compliance questions to the external accountant.



### 9. Bookkeeping & Bank Reconciliation

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date Xero accounts.

- Reconcile bank accounts and payment transactions.

- Investigate unmatched or incorrectly allocated transactions.

- Review transaction descriptions, account codes and GST treatment.

- Collect missing receipts, invoices and supporting documents.

- Identify duplicate payments or transactions.

- Maintain accurate customer and supplier balances.

- Refer uncertain accounting or tax matters to our external accountant.



### 10. Fixed Costs & Subscription Management

- Maintain a register of recurring business expenses.

- Track rent, insurance, software subscriptions, vehicle expenses, finance repayments and other fixed costs.

- Monitor renewal dates, notice periods and upcoming payments.

- Identify unnecessary subscriptions and duplicate charges.

- Report cost increases and potential savings.

- Prepare recommendations for management review.



### 11. Scheduled Payments & Cash Commitments

- Prepare payment schedules for supplier invoices, installer invoices, payroll and recurring expenses.

- Confirm amounts, supporting documents and due dates.

- Identify urgent payments and overdue liabilities.

- Prepare projected cash requirements.

- Submit payment batches for director approval.

- Track approved and completed payments.



**Bank payment authorisation and release remain the responsibility of company directors or other specifically authorised personnel.**



### 12. Inventory, Stock Costs & Job Profitability

- Maintain accurate equipment purchase costs in Xero.

- Assist with inventory and stock cost tracking.

- Reconcile supplier purchases against confirmed warehouse stock records.

- Track equipment costs, installer charges, labour and other direct job expenses.

- Allocate costs to the correct installation jobs.

- Calculate revenue, direct costs and gross profit for completed jobs.

- Identify missing costs, incorrect allocations and unexplained stock discrepancies.

- Prepare job profitability summaries for management.



Physical stock counts will be performed or confirmed by onsite warehouse personnel.



## Financial Reporting Responsibilities



The Finance Officer will be responsible for preparing regular financial reports to assist management with business decisions.



### Fortnightly Finance Report



Prepare a report covering:



**1. Cash Position**

- Current bank balances and available funds.

- Upcoming payroll, tax and other commitments.

- Expected cash requirements.



**2. Money Coming In**

- Outstanding customer invoices.

- Overdue customer payments.

- Expected Brighte settlements.

- Outstanding STC proceeds.

- Expected payment dates.



**3. Money Going Out**

- Supplier bills due.

- Installer payments due.

- Payroll obligations.

- Rent, insurance and recurring expenses.



**4. Supplier Credit**

- Supplier credit limits.

- Current outstanding balances.

- Open purchase orders.

- Remaining available credit.



**5. Cash Flow Forecast**

- Expected incoming and outgoing funds.

- Projected cash position for the next 8–12 weeks.

- Potential cash shortages or upcoming financial risks.



**6. Issues Requiring Management Attention**

- Overdue customer accounts.

- Supplier payment disputes.

- Missing credits.

- Unreconciled transactions.

- Financial approvals required.



### Monthly Finance Report



Prepare a comprehensive monthly financial report including:



- Profit and Loss Statement – monthly and year-to-date.

- Balance Sheet.

- Revenue by solar, battery and electrical installation categories.

- Completed job profitability and gross margins.

- Operating expenses and overheads.

- Budget versus actual expenditure, where budgets are available.

- Customer accounts receivable ageing.

- Supplier accounts payable ageing.

- Supplier credit utilisation.

- Stock valuation and inventory discrepancies.

- Payroll, superannuation and tax liabilities.

- Fixed cost and subscription changes.

- Outstanding accounting issues requiring accountant review.



Clearly identify any figures that are incomplete, estimated or awaiting reconciliation.



## Daily, Weekly & Monthly Working Routine



### Daily

- Check customer receipts.

- Issue invoices when payment milestones are reached.

- Enter and review supplier bills.

- Update outstanding customer and supplier balances.

- Monitor urgent Brighte and STC settlements.

- Escalate urgent financial issues.



### Weekly

- Complete bank and account reconciliations.

- Follow up overdue customer payments.

- Update supplier credit registers.

- Review outstanding Brighte and STC payments.

- Prepare upcoming payment schedules.

- Review recurring expenses and commitments.

- Coordinate outstanding matters with the Compliance Officer.



### Each Payroll Cycle

- Review approved timesheets.

- Prepare payroll.

- Submit payroll summary for director approval.

- Complete authorised payroll reporting and record keeping.



### Fortnightly

- Submit the cash flow and financial commitments report.

- Identify outstanding debts, upcoming expenses and management decisions required.



### Monthly

- Complete month-end reconciliations.

- Prepare financial statements and management reports.

- Review job profitability and stock costs.

- Identify unresolved accounting discrepancies.

- Coordinate outstanding accounting matters with our external accountants.



## Systems & Software



**Essential:**

- Xero – bookkeeping, invoicing, bills, reconciliation and reporting.

- Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets – financial tracking and reporting.

- Strong understanding of Australian GST and bookkeeping practices.



**Highly Desirable:**

- ClickUp – job tracking and communication.

- Brighte – finance settlement tracking.

- Experience with inventory and job costing systems.

- Australian payroll, STP and superannuation administration.

- Experience working with Australian accountants.



## Required Experience & Skills



- Previous experience as a Finance Officer, Bookkeeper or Accounts Officer.

- Strong practical experience using Xero.

- Experience with Australian business accounting and GST.

- Knowledge of accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Experience performing bank reconciliations.

- Ability to prepare financial reports and cash flow forecasts.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to manage deadlines and work independently.

- High level of confidentiality and professionalism.

- Ability to identify financial discrepancies and proactively resolve issues.



### Preferred Industry Experience



Candidates with previous experience in the following industries will receive priority consideration:



1. Australian solar and battery installation companies.

2. Australian electrical contracting businesses.

3. Australian construction and trade services.

4. Businesses using Xero for inventory, job costing and financial reporting.



## Working Arrangements



- Remote position based in the Philippines.

- Initially 24 hours per week, across three working days.

- Working hours aligned with Sydney, Australia.

- Opportunity to increase hours based on performance and business requirements.

- Long-term employment opportunity for the right candidate.



## First Priorities After Joining



The successful candidate will initially focus on:



1. Reviewing our existing Xero setup and identifying outstanding bookkeeping issues.

2. Bringing bank reconciliations and financial records up to date.

3. Verifying opening customer and supplier balances.

4. Establishing accurate customer receivables and supplier payables tracking.

5. Creating supplier credit limit and outstanding balance registers.

6. Establishing a fixed cost and subscription register.

7. Setting up fortnightly financial reporting.

8. Establishing monthly Profit and Loss, cash flow and job profitability reporting.

9. Working with the Compliance Officer to establish clear financial handover procedures.

10. Identifying discrepancies requiring review by management or our external accountants.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application.



### Xero & Accounting Experience



1. How many years of experience do you have working as a Finance Officer or Bookkeeper?

2. How many years have you worked with Australian businesses?

3. How would you rate your Xero experience, and which Xero functions have you used?

4. Have you managed accounts payable, accounts receivable and bank reconciliations in Xero?

5. Do you have experience with Australian GST, BAS preparation, payroll, STP and superannuation?

6. Have you prepared monthly Profit and Loss statements, balance sheets and cash flow reports?



### Industry & Financial Management

title: Phone Appointment Setter for US General Contractors (Roofers, Remodelers & More), Commission-Based, 3 Openings
description:
TITLE:

Friendly Phone Appointment Setter for US General Contractors (Roofers, Remodelers & More), Commission-Based, 3 Openings



HI THERE!

We're Piedmont Websites & Automations, a small company in Greensboro, NC. We help contractors stop losing jobs when they miss a call. Our service sends an automatic text right away, so the customer stays and the contractor gets the job. Learn more at 
.



We're hiring 3 friendly, reliable people to help us reach contractors by phone, and you won't be figuring things out alone.



WHO I AM

My name is Hassan, and I'm from Greensboro. I started Piedmont because I kept seeing great local businesses that nobody could find online. Good people doing good work. My background is in corporate IT, remote sales (including time learning high-ticket sales), and e-commerce, and today I build AI and automation tools for local businesses. My first client got their first inbound lead within 72 hours of launching, and that confirmed everything. I know what it's like to learn sales from the ground up, so I want this to be a role where you feel comfortable asking questions and growing.



THE ROLE

You'll call newly registered US general contractors (roofers, remodelers, and similar), mostly owner-operators and small crews. You'll have a friendly conversation, see if what we offer sounds helpful, and book a short call with me on our calendar. You don't close anything. I handle the demo and the sign-up.



A typical day:

- About 100 calls, five days a week

- If nobody picks up, call again, then send a short text from our template

- Book interested owners and log everything in our tracker



WHAT YOU GET

- A fresh, researched list of newly registered local general contractors, with owner names and numbers looked up wherever we can find them

- Sales training before you dial, plus a call script and answers to common questions

- A practice call with me, feedback on your calls, and a weekly check-in

- Our calling and tracking tools, a demo video to send to owners, and a small team chat



PAY

This is commission only, with no base pay:

- $20 for every booked call where the owner or decision maker joins for at least [10] minutes

- A $75 bonus when a client signs up and pays their first month

- Paid weekly through [PayPal / Wise]. Bonuses are paid once the client's first payment clears.



What to expect: with about 100 calls a day, five days a week, a typical rep can expect around 5 booked calls a week, about 3 attended, and 2 to 3 clients signing per month. That adds up to roughly $450 per month on target. This is a typical estimate, not a guarantee. Your first weeks will likely be lower while you learn the script, and your earnings can grow as you improve.



WHERE THIS CAN GROW

If you do great work, our goal is to add base pay and open roles like sales manager.



YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU

- Have phone experience with US businesses (contractors or home services is a bonus)

- Speak clear, friendly English and can call during US hours ([9 AM to 5 PM Eastern])

- Have a quiet space, steady internet, and a headset



HOW TO APPLY

We'd love to hear from you! Please start your message with the word CALLS so we know you read this, then tell us:

1. What's your experience with phone calls to customers or businesses?

2. If a contractor says, "I'm on a job, can you just send me an
?", what would you say?

3. Are you comfortable with commission-based pay, and what hours work for you?



To finish, please record a short 15 to 30 second voice message reading this opener and share the link: "Hey, this is [Name]. I'll be upfront with you, this is a cold call. Would you like to hang up, or give me 30 seconds?"



We read every application and reply to everyone. Thanks so much for your interest!

title: High-Ticket Sales Closer — Inbound
description:
We're hiring experienced high-ticket closers for inbound calls only.



$2,100 AUD per enrolment. Uncapped.

KPI: 8 commitment fees a month. You're paid $2,100 per enrolment that follows, and we usually find those who pay the commitment fee almost always commence for enrolment.

OTE: $201,600 AUD a year for a closer hitting target.

60-day ramp: an additional $1,500 AUD/month while you learn the product, non-recoverable, on top of your commission.



ABOUT LICENCEPATH



We help experienced tradies and workers — carpenters, electricians, bricklayers and more — get their trade certificate and licence so they can take the next step in their career.



This is a regulated industry and a legal requirement for every tradie to have. Plenty of good tradesmen have the skills and the years on the tools but not the piece of paper the government requires to work for themselves, charge properly, or run their own jobs. We close that gap — through short-course gap-training and recognition of the experience they already have — and get them licensed much faster than the traditional way. We're talking years to weeks.



For the tradesman, a licence changes everything: their own contracts, uncapped income, the freedom to run their own show. For you, it's a sales role you can actually stand behind. You're not talking anyone into anything they don't need — you're helping someone unlock the career they've already earned. That's rare in sales, and it makes the job easier and the money better.



We have our own blue ocean, focusing on specific licences that are very difficult for anyone else to offer. There's barely any competition. So it's not hard to show people the value in this.



THE ROLE



Every lead has already filled out an eligibility form to check whether they can get their trade licence through gap-training or experience. So they've put their hand up before you ever speak to them. No cold calling. No prospecting. No chasing dead leads.



Your job: get on the phone, explain the process, handle the objections, and move them down the line toward getting licensed.



These are government-regulated licences — a legal requirement to work in their trade. The customer needs this. We just make it faster and simpler than doing it alone. That makes the sale close to a no-brainer, and your job is to push it over the line.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Take inbound calls from people who've already checked their eligibility

Explain the pathway clearly, in plain language

Handle the objections that come up — price, time, requirements

Guide them through commitment and enrolment

Keep 
ntum: every lead called fast, every deal followed through



WHAT YOU EARN



$2,100 AUD per enrolment, paid upfront. Uncapped.

KPI: 8 commitment fees paid a month.

OTE: $201,600 AUD+ a year.



WHO WE WANT



You've closed high-ticket over the phone before — real deals, real objections, real money.

You hold a price. You don't fold the 
nt someone pushes for a discount.

You can talk to a tradesman. Our customers are blunt and sceptical.

Clear, confident English on the phone.

You know how to work a sales cycle.

You understand the importance of speed to lead.

You're a hunter — not someone looking for a clock-on, clock-off job. You understand that when a lead comes in, that's a $2,100 phone call waiting, and you're not going to let it sit until it burns.



BEFORE YOU APPLY — TIMEZONE



We're based in New South Wales, Australia (AEST/AEDT), and our leads cluster around two windows: 7–10am and 1–4pm Sydney time. Those are the hours the phone runs hot and the ones that matter most for speed to lead.



Wherever you are in the world, apply — but be honest with yourself about whether you can be live and hunting during those Sydney windows. Work out what they land at in your timezone before you send your note. If those hours don't work for your life, this seat won't either.



HOW TO APPLY



Send us a Loom or voice note — your choice — answering these questions:



Where have you worked?

What have you sold before?

What was your biggest commission month, and what were you selling?

Tell us the story of your biggest close.

Why did you leave your last role?

What are you looking for in a career job?



Keep it loose — two to five minutes. We want to hear how you actually sound, so record it yourself rather than reading a script.



Include the link to your recording in your application message.



WAGE/SALARY

$2,100 AUD per enrolment + $1,500 AUD/month ramp (60 days)

title: Meta Ads Creative Strategist – Ecommerce/DTC | Scripts, Briefs, Angles & Full-Funnel Testing
description:
About us

We are a growing ecommerce brand, and Meta Ads is our main acquisition channel. Our editors already produce the content. What we need now is the strategic mind who d
 what we make, for whom, why, and when to test it, and who turns those decisions into scripts and briefs our editors can execute. You will work closely with the founder and the editing team, and you will have real influence on the brand's creative direction.



The role

You will own creative strategy on Meta and turn it into execution. That means writing the scripts and creative briefs our editors work from every week. You will find new angles and avatars, stay ahead of what is working in the market, and build a testing process that consistently produces winners. We want someone who brings ideas, challenges assumptions and pushes innovation. We do not want someone who waits to be told what to do.



What you'll do



Study the niche in depth: Amazon reviews, Reddit, forums, comments, competitor ads and the Meta Ad Library, to uncover pain points, desires, objections and the customer's real language

Find and develop new avatars and angles, and keep a living angle bank mapped to funnel stage and awareness level

Plan creative across TOF, MOF and BOF, knowing what each stage needs and how it connects to the others

Track market trends, formats and hook styles, and spot what is worth adapting before it becomes saturated

Write ad scripts for every format we run (UGC, founder-led, demos, comparisons, voiceover, native-style content), covering hook variations, body, proof and CTA

Write detailed creative briefs for the editors: objective, avatar, angle, funnel stage, format, hook options, script, visual direction, references and what we are testing

Write copy for statics and carousels, including headlines, primary text and on-image text

D
 what to test, when, and why: new concepts vs. iterations, hook variations, format tests

Read performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, hook rate, hold rate, frequency, AOV, CVR) and turn insights into the next round of creative

Work directly with the founder on strategy, and with the editors on execution, reviewing their cuts and giving clear, actionable feedback



What we're looking for



Proven experience as a creative strategist for ecommerce/DTC brands on Meta Ads

Strong scriptwriting skills: you know how to write hooks that stop the scroll and scripts that hold attention and convert, adapted to each funnel stage

Experience writing clear, detailed creative briefs that editors can execute without guesswork

Deep knowledge of formats, hooks and creative structures that perform on Meta today (UGC, founder-led, demos, comparisons, statics, carousels, native-style content, and more)

Strong understanding of avatars, angles, awareness levels and funnel stages

Solid grasp of the numbers behind an ecommerce business: ROAS, CPA, breakeven ROAS, margins, AOV, CVR, and how creative performance affects profitability

Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager: you don't need to be a media buyer, but you must be able to read an account and draw creative conclusions from it

A research-first mindset: you dig into reviews, Reddit and customer conversations before writing a single hook

Proactive and strategic: you bring ideas, propose tests and explain the reasoning behind them

Excellent written English and clear communication

A portfolio with real examples of scripts, briefs, angle docs or ads you strategized, ideally with results



Nice to have



Direct-response copywriting background

Experience with creative analytics or inspiration tools (Motion, Foreplay, Atria or similar)

Experience across multiple niches or brands



This role is not for you if



You are mainly a video editor or UGC creator, without strategy and research experience

You are a pure media buyer with no creative background

You only provide ideas or strategy decks and don't write the scripts and briefs yourself

Your experience is mostly in lead gen, local businesses or agency work outside ecommerce

You cannot show concrete examples of your work



Engagement

Ongoing collaboration. Hours and structure are flexible and will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

title: Video Editor & AI Creative Strategist — Meta Ads (Ecommerce / Digital Products)
description:
Are YOU an experienced video editor who specializes in Meta Ads for ecommerce brands? Can you look at a competitor's winning ad and immediately understand why it works — the hook, the pacing, the clip choice, the emotional beat — and replicate that thinking, not just the edit?

If you answered an enthusiastic "YES," KEEP READING.

We run an international ecommerce brand selling both physical and digital products (ebooks, video courses) to English-speaking audiences in the US, UK, EU, and Australia. We're looking for a dedicated, full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and eventually grow into Head of Video Editing.

We're not chasing virality. Our goal is one thing: ads that stop the scroll and sell. Every video needs a hook strong enough to interrupt scrolling, and an edit that keeps attention high all the way through.

What you'll own:

Sales-Focused Ad Production: Editing high-conversion Meta ads from scripts we provide — built to sell, not to go viral.

AI Scene Generation & Recreation: Hands-on fluency with AI video tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, and similar) to generate or recreate scenes and B-roll when what we have isn't enough — you don't wait for footage, you create it.

Clip Curation & Sourcing: We'll provide a folder of selected B-rolls; if additional clips are needed, you source or generate them autonomously. High-quality only — traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

Script-to-Screen Interpretation: We give you the hook and body copy; you d
 pacing, cuts, and visual rhythm to maximize watch-through and conversion.

Strategic Input, Not Just Execution: We want a creative partner, not a pair of hands. You should actively propose new hooks, new formats, and new angles based on what you're seeing perform — not wait to be told what to test next.

Constant Trend Awareness: You're the kind of editor who's already testing a new AI tool or ad format before we ask about it. Staying ahead of trends in short-form ad creative is part of the job, not an extra.

Subtitle & Detail Precision: Clean, perfectly synced subtitles, no typos, no timing errors — this is an area where we accept zero compromise.

Reliable, On-Time Delivery: Every deadline is a real deadline. Late deliveries disrupt the whole ad pipeline, and consistency here matters as much as editing skill.

Position Requirements:

Full-time availability. This is not a 2-hours-a-day gig. If you're currently juggling 5–6 different clients and can't guarantee us priority and focus, please don't apply.

Immediate or near-immediate start.

2+ years of specific experience editing Meta Ads for ecommerce brands — physical product experience is fine, but experience with digital products (ebooks, courses, info-products) is a strong plus.

Practical experience with AI video generation tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, or equivalents) — this is not optional, it's core to how we produce content now.

Fluent English — our team and all creative content are in English; you need to understand tone, nuance, and pacing at a native or near-native level.

Strong grasp of hook, retention, and pacing — you should be able to explain why a cut works, not just execute it.

A strategic, growth-minded approach — you think about what's next for the brand's creative, not just what's on today's task list.

Weekend availability when needed, paid accordingly.

Obsessive attention to detail. Subtitles, transitions, and timing must be clean. Mediocrity isn't tolerated on this team.

Genuine passion for the craft of editing, and for staying current with where it's heading.

What We Offer:

Performance bonuses tied to ad results, starting from month one.

Real growth path to Head of Video Editing as the brand scales.

Direct involvement in an international brand's creative strategy — your instincts and proposals shape what we test next.

title: $500/Month — Wedding Video Editor | Paid Training, Constant Work, Weekly Pay | Long-Term
description:
We are a wedding-video business looking for reliable Adobe Premiere Pro editors who want a long-term position and a steady flow of paid work.



THE JOB OFFER



• Ongoing wedding-video editing in small, clearly defined assignments

• Weekly payment through PayPal for approved work

• An average of US$500 per month

• A clear path from a short skills assessment to paid training and then regular paid work with our team



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



• Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro

• A Windows PC suitable for running Adobe Premiere Pro; this workflow is PC-based

• Ability to receive payments through PayPal

• Careful attention to instructions and detail

• Fast, dependable delivery and responsive communication

• Conversational English

• Availability Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during training. After training, you can work whenever you like, as long as you meet all deadlines.

• Willingness to ask questions and report progress



Previous wedding or multicamera editing experience is welcome, but it is not required. Some of our best editors joined us without any wedding-editing experience.



STEP 1: SHORT SKILLS ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted candidates complete a brief paid editing assessment before training, for which you will be paid. The assessment uses real wedding footage from a project that was completed and delivered several years ago. You will not send us the Adobe Premiere Pro project file. You will submit only timeline screenshots and low-quality video renders so we can review the timing of your cuts, the beats, and which shots you selected—nothing more. The assessment consists of an already synced five-minute multicam timeline and a 30-second reception timeline and should take approximately 10 minutes of editing time if you have some experience editing in Adobe Premiere Pro. It is used to confirm that you can understand the workflow, follow instructions accurately, communicate well, and deliver on time.



STEP 2: PAID TRAINING



Candidates who pass the test enter paid training. You receive access to our learning platform, training videos, tutorials, and guidance from a personal tutor during the training hours above. Training continues until you reach the editing standard required for ongoing work. The training rate and milestones will be confirmed before training begins.



ONGOING PAID WORK AND CONTINUED TRAINING



Once you complete the initial training, you will begin receiving a constant flow of paid wedding-video assignments with synced material and clear instructions. Our syncers handle synchronization, our ML system supplies the preprocessed multicam, you vet the result, and our QC team reviews the complete multicam.



The learning does not stop when the paid work begins. Your real assignments will go hand in hand with continued training as you learn every part of our wedding-video workflow. You will progress step by step through the different types of edits until you reach the highest level: creating complete wedding highlights.



We are looking for editors who want to stay, improve, take on more responsibility, and become long-term members of our team.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CEREMONY so we know you read the full post.

2. Include a 30-second audio introduction. This is required so we can assess your spoken English.

3. Confirm that you work on a Windows PC.

4. Confirm that you can receive payments through PayPal.

5. Confirm that you can be available Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during paid training.

6. If you have edited wedding videos before, you are welcome to include one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional; previous wedding-editing experience is not required.

title: Overseas AI SaaS Sales Manager
description:

You will primarily engage with company founders, technical leaders, product managers, procurement teams, and business decision-makers. Your role will be to help customers understand the value of our products and drive the practical implementation of AI capabilities in their businesses.



Responsibilities：

1. Proactively develop enterprise customers through customer research, cold calls,
, social media, industry events, partnership channels, and other methods.

2. Identify customer needs related to AI APIs, model access, application development, cost control, reliability, and technical integration.

7. Continuously collect market, competitive, and customer feedback, and provide recommendations for product positioning, pricing, and sales strategies.

8. Meet performance targets set by the team, including new customer acquisition, contract value, payment collection, and sales cycle length.

1. Strong English communication skills, with the ability to communicate directly with customers verbally.

2. At least two years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, cloud services, APIs, software services, AI products, or enterprise products.

3. Proven experience in proactive customer acquisition and independently closing deals, with the ability to build customer relationships from the ground up.

4. Strong communication skills with technical leaders, product managers, business executives, and procurement professionals.

5. Excellent capabilities in needs discovery, commercial negotiation, solution presentation, and deal execution.

- Number of new paying customers

- Qualified pipeline value and conversion rate

- Win rate and sales cycle length

- Payment collection rate

- Actual product usage after new customer onboarding

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM Manila Time (occasional overtime may be required)

Hiring: ASAP



About KOPS



KOPS is a growing media company based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, led by Jordi, one of the biggest content creators on YouTube. Our main YouTube channel has over 15 million subscribers, alongside our gaming channel with over 5 million subscribers.



We operate in the fast-paced world of YouTube, digital entertainment, and media, creating opportunities to expand our reach through strategic partnerships and content licensing.



We are looking for a talented Filipino Sales Licensing Manager to join our growing international team. This is an opportunity for an experienced sales professional who understands the YouTube and media industry, knows how to communicate with business partners, and has the ability to turn opportunities into successful deals.



About the Role



We need someone who can take ownership of our licensing sales process from start to finish. You will be responsible for managing incoming licensing inquiries, engaging with prospective clients, presenting our channels and content, conducting sales calls, negotiating agreements, and following through until contracts are signed.



This is not a purely administrative position. We need someone who is confident speaking with clients, understands the business they are selling into, and can independently move opportunities forward without constant supervision.



You will work directly with our licensing pipeline and use HubSpot to manage active deals, review client conversations, track upcoming calls, identify opportunities that need follow-up, and ensure that no potential deal is left unattended.



What You Will Do



You will manage our licensing inbox and respond to incoming inquiries, ensuring that potential partners receive timely and professional communication. You will review active opportunities in HubSpot, monitor upcoming calls, follow up with clients who have questions, and reconnect with prospects who have not yet made a decision.



You will lead sales conversations with potential licensing partners, confidently pitch KOPS's YouTube channels and content, explain our licensing opportunities, address client questions, and handle objections. You will be expected to understand what we offer and communicate its commercial value to prospective buyers and partners.



You will manage the entire sales cycle, from qualifying interested prospects and arranging meetings to conducting calls, negotiating commercial terms, coordinating contracts, and following through until the deal is closed. You will also maintain accurate records in HubSpot, update deal stages, document conversations, and ensure every active opportunity has a clear next step.



You will proactively identify opportunities to grow our licensing business, build relationships with relevant media companies and commercial partners, and help improve our sales processes and conversion rates. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through on commitments, and understands that consistent communication is essential to closing deals.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for a candidate with extensive end-to-end sales experience and a strong background in YouTube, digital media, entertainment, content licensing, or a related industry. You should understand how the media business operates and be familiar with the commercial opportunities surrounding YouTube content and distribution.



You must have excellent written and spoken English and be comfortable leading professional conversations with international clients. You should be confident presenting offers, negotiating terms, handling objections, and persuading potential partners to move forward.



Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM platforms is highly desirable. You should know how to manage a sales pipeline, prioritize active deals, track follow-ups, and maintain accurate client records.



We need someone who is proactive, organized, commercially minded, and capable of working independently in a remote environment. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your own pipeline, identifying what needs to happen next, and acting without waiting for someone to tell you what to do.



Most importantly, you must know your line of business. We are looking for someone who already understands sales and the YouTube or media industry, rather than someone who needs to learn the fundamentals from scratch.



Work Schedule and Opportunity



This is a fully remote, part-time position with a regular schedule of Monday to Friday, from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM Manila Time. Occasional overtime may be necessary to accommodate client calls, negotiations, or important business opportunities.



As KOPS continues to expand, this position has the potential to transition into a full-time role for the right candidate. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company and contribute to building a successful licensing operation.



We are looking to hire as soon as possible.



How to Apply



If you believe you have the experience, industry knowledge, and confidence to succeed in this role, please send your updated resume and a short video introduction to 
 with a subject line: Sales KOPS.



In your video, introduce yourself, explain your experience in end-to-end sales, highlight your background in YouTube or media, and tell us why you would be a strong fit for this position.



Please ensure your video is professionally recorded, with clear audio and appropriate presentation. Speak confidently and naturally, as if you were speaking directly to a potential client. Do not read from a script. We want to see your genuine communication skills, confidence, and ability to present yourself professionally.



Applications without a video introduction may not be prioritized.



If you are an experienced sales professional who understands YouTube and media, knows how to build client relationships, and can confidently turn opportunities into closed deals, we would love to hear from you.

title: Solar & Battery Compliance / Operations Officer – Australian Solar Industry
description:
# Solar & Battery Compliance & Operations Officer – Australian Solar Industry



**Company:** AusGreen Energy Group Pty Ltd  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Employment:** Part-Time – 24 hours per week  

**Salary:** AUD $8–15 per hour (negotiable based on experience)



## About Us



AusGreen Energy Group is an Australian renewable energy company based in Sydney, NSW, specialising in residential and commercial solar PV systems, battery storage and electrical installations.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organised and proactive **Solar & Battery Compliance & Operations Officer** to manage installation administration, job coordination, compliance documentation and operational workflows.



The successful candidate will be responsible for progressing each job from the moment a customer accepts a proposal through to installation completion, compliance submission and customer handover.



Previous experience working with an Australian solar or battery installation company is strongly preferred.



**Candidates with additional experience in Meta Ads, digital marketing or website development will receive higher priority during the recruitment process.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Accepted Proposals – OpenSolar

- Review accepted customer proposals in OpenSolar.

- Verify customer details, installation address, system specifications and accepted scope.

- Check equipment details, pricing and payment terms.

- Identify missing information and escalate discrepancies to management.



### 2. Job Creation & Management – ClickUp

- Create and maintain customer jobs in ClickUp.

- Assign job numbers and upload accepted proposals.

- Upload customer photos, electricity bills and supporting documentation.

- Record salesperson, payment method and installation requirements.

- Follow up missing customer information.

- Keep job statuses accurate and up to date.



### 3. Payment Route Coordination – Brighte / Bank Transfer

- Confirm whether customers are paying through Brighte finance or bank transfer.

- Prepare and follow up Brighte finance applications.

- Request deposit invoices from the Finance Officer for bank-transfer customers.

- Confirm with finance that required deposits have been received.

- Progress jobs only once the applicable payment requirements have been satisfied.



**Note:** The Compliance Officer does not issue invoices, reconcile payments or manage customer accounts.



### 4. Permission to Connect (PTC)

- Prepare and submit PTC applications using approved system designs and technical information.

- Track application statuses and approvals.

- Follow up outstanding applications.

- Refer technical restrictions or required design changes to management.

- Ensure required connection approvals are obtained before installation.



### 5. Form Panda – Job Documentation

- Create installation jobs in Form Panda.

- Prepare installation forms and documentation.

- Obtain required customer and installer signatures.

- Verify that customer details, equipment and installation scope match OpenSolar and ClickUp.



### 6. Installation Preparation & Scheduling

- Prepare installation job sheets and installer documentation packs.

- Coordinate installation dates with customers and installers.

- Confirm equipment and stock availability with onsite warehouse staff.

- Ensure required customer photos, approvals and installation details are available.

- Confirm the job is ready for installation.

- Obtain management's technical release before dispatch.



### 7. Post-Installation Compliance Review

- Collect installation photos, equipment serial numbers and commissioning records.

- Check CCEWs, compliance forms, customer declarations and installer documentation.

- Review submitted documents against company compliance checklists.

- Identify missing or incorrect documentation.

- Follow up installers for outstanding evidence.

- Track rectification requests until resolved.

- Escalate technical compliance concerns to management for approval.



### 8. STC Documentation & Submission

- Prepare complete STC documentation packs.

- Submit completed job files to the company's authorised STC retailer or aggregator.

- Track submission acceptance and documentation requests.

- Follow up outstanding documents and resolve administrative queries.

- Provide submission references and expected proceeds to the Finance Officer.



This role involves preparing and submitting job documentation, not managing STC trading, aggregator accounts or financial reconciliation.



### 9. Brighte Completion & Settlement Documentation

- Prepare and submit required Brighte completion paperwork.

- Check customer declarations and signatures.

- Track settlement processing and follow up outstanding documentation.

- Provide settlement references and expected amounts to finance.



The Finance Officer is responsible for verifying actual payments received.



### 10. Customer Handover

- Prepare and send completed customer handover packs.

- Include CCEWs, equipment warranties, manuals and applicable compliance documents.

- Record when documents have been sent.

- Track customer app setup and handover completion.

- Escalate unresolved customer handover issues.



### 11. Job Completion & Installer Payment Readiness

- Update ClickUp when installation and compliance paperwork are complete.

- Confirm all required records are filed.

- Identify outstanding rectifications or incomplete items.

- Obtain technical completion approval from management.

- Notify the Finance Officer when installer invoices are ready for review.



The Compliance Officer does not approve or process installer payments.



## Systems & Software



Experience with the following platforms is highly desirable:



- **OpenSolar** – proposals and accepted system designs

- **ClickUp** – job tracking and workflow management

- **Form Panda** – installation and compliance documentation

- **Brighte** – finance applications and completion paperwork

- **Australian DNSP portals** – PTC applications

- **STC submission portals** – compliance documentation



Training will be provided on our internal procedures.



## Required Experience & Skills



- Previous experience in Australian solar or battery installation administration is strongly preferred.

- Experience coordinating installers and installation bookings.

- Understanding of Australian solar and battery compliance documentation.

- Familiarity with CCEWs, PTC applications and STC submission requirements.

- Strong attention to detail and document management skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Ability to follow established workflows and manage multiple jobs independently.

- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

- Comfortable working with Australian customers, installers and management.

- Ability to meet deadlines and proactively follow up outstanding tasks.



## Additional Preferred Skills – Meta Ads & Website Development



We are particularly interested in candidates who can offer additional skills beyond solar and battery compliance.



**Candidates with proven experience in digital marketing, Meta Ads or website development will have a stronger chance of being selected for this position.**



### A. Meta Ads & Digital Marketing

- Experience managing
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Creating, launching and optimising Meta Ads campaigns.

- Experience using Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager.

- Understanding of lead generation campaigns, targeting and audience management.

- Monitoring advertising performance, cost per lead and conversions.

- Experience running advertising campaigns for Australian businesses.

- Solar and battery lead generation experience is a significant advantage.



### B. Website Development & Management

- Experience creating, editing and maintaining business websites.

- Knowledge of WordPress, Shopify or similar website platforms.

- Ability to create and update landing pages.

- Understanding of basic SEO and website optimisation.

- Experience connecting website enquiry forms with CRM systems.

- Ability to troubleshoot website issues and make content updates.

- Experience improving website conversion rates and customer enquiries.



### Additional Skills Selection Advantage



Applicants who demonstrate experience across the following areas will receive priority consideration:



1. Australian solar and battery compliance administration.

2. Meta Ads management and lead generation.

3. Website development, maintenance and optimisation.



**Solar and battery compliance will remain the primary responsibility of the position. Marketing and website development skills are highly valued additional capabilities, not mandatory requirements.**



## Working Arrangements



- Remote position based in the Philippines.

- Initially 24 hours per week, across three working days.

- Working hours aligned with Sydney, Australia.

- Opportunity to increase working hours based on performance and business requirements.

- Long-term opportunity for the right candidate.



## How to Apply



Please answer all the following questions in your application.



### Solar & Battery Experience



1. How many years have you worked for an Australian solar or battery company?

2. Which Australian solar companies have you previously worked with, and what were your responsibilities?

3. Have you used OpenSolar, ClickUp, Form Panda or Brighte? Please specify your experience with each platform.

4. Have you prepared PTC applications using Australian electricity distributor portals?

5. Have you reviewed CCEWs, installation photos, compliance documentation and STC submissions?

6. Have you coordinated installation bookings and followed up installers for missing documents?

7. Describe the steps you would take after a customer accepts a solar and battery proposal, through to installation completion and customer handover.



### Meta Ads & Website Experience



8. Have you managed
 or Instagram advertising campaigns using Meta Ads Manager?

9. Have you generated leads through Meta Ads? If yes, please describe your results, including cost per lead where available.

10. Have you worked on advertising campaigns for Australian solar or battery companies?

11. Have you built, managed or maintained websites? Which platforms have you used?

12. Can you create landing pages, update website content and connect enquiry forms to CRM systems?

13. Please provide examples of advertising campaigns or websites you have worked on, explaining your specific contribution.



### Availability & Salary



14. What is your expected hourly rate in AUD?

15. Are you available to work 24 hours per week during Sydney business hours?

16. When would you be available to start?



## Important Application Instructions



Please begin your application with the words **"SOLAR COMPLIANCE"** to confirm you have read the full job description.



Applications that do not answer the screening questions may not be considered.



We are looking for a reliable, proactive and detail-oriented long-term team member who can take ownership of our compliance and installation administration processes, communicate effectively and contribute to the continued growth of AusGreen Energy Group.



**We look forward to hearing from you!**

* Turn meaningful discussions about life, relationships, personal growth, and success into shareable content.



Your Responsibilities



* Review uploaded TikTok LIVE recordings ranging from 1–8 hours.

* Independently identify the strongest moments with viral potential.

* Select clips based on humor, emotion, entertainment value, educational value, and audience engagement.

* Edit engaging vertical videos (9:16) optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

* Add accurate, engaging captions, dynamic cuts, zooms, and appropriate visual effects. WHERE IT WOULD FIT BEST, no one to have captions and not to have captions no one to do dynamic zooms and when not to etc. 

* Create attention-grabbing opening hooks that encourage viewers to keep watching.

* Remove unnecessary pauses and dead air and distractions without losing important context.

* Understand when a clip should be funny, emotional, educational, inspirational, or thought-provoking.

* Organize and deliver completed clips consistently.



What I’m Looking For:



The most important skill is your ability to recognize a GREAT moment without me having to point it out.



You should have:



* Strong experience editing TikTok, Reels, or YouTube Shorts.

* An excellent understanding of viral content and viewer retention.

* Strong English comprehension, including American humor, slang, and cultural references.

* The ability to understand emotional, serious, comedic, and inspirational conversations.

* Experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.

* Strong attention to detail and excellent communication.

* The ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

* Creativity and good judgment when selecting clips.



Experience editing podcasts, livestreams, interviews, or long-form content is a major plus.



What Success Looks Like



I want someone who can watch a four-hour livestream and recognize:



* The 15-second moment that could make thousands of people laugh.

* The 45-second conversation that could inspire someone to change their life.

* The unexpected celebrity response that people will want to share.

* The powerful Bible study discussion that sparks hundreds of comments.

* The business advice that makes viewers stop scrolling and save the video.



I want an editor who thinks like a content creator, not just someone who operates editing software.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your editing experience.

2. Links to 3–10 examples of short-form clips/videos you’ve edited.

3. Your experience working with long-form livestreams, podcasts, or interviews.

4. Your expected hourly rate or preferred payment structure.

5. Your availability and typical turnaround time.



Bonus: Tell me what you believe makes a short-form video go viral.



Final Note



I’m looking to build a long-term working relationship with someone who is creative, reliable, and genuinely understands content.



This is an opportunity to work with a wide variety of content, including entertainment, celebrity interviews, comedy, faith, education, and motivation.



If you have an eye for moments that people can’t help but watch, laugh at, learn from, or share, I want to hear from you!

title: Associate Content Specialist
description:

Curiosity about how AI support tools surface knowledge content.

Interest in growing across multiple content formats over time.

HMO coverage

Wellness Perks

For this remote role,  occasional travel to our Manila office is expected for in-person collaboration up to 3 times a year.

If you're hungry to do the best work of your career, on a product that actually matters, let's talk.

NICE TO HAVE

title: Short-Form Video Editor and Graphic Designer
description:
About Us

We are a small Australian performance marketing consultancy. We run Google and Meta ads for businesses in Australia, Europe and the US. Our founder worked at Google and Meta before starting the company. We all work remotely.



About The Role

We are looking for a short-form video editor who also designs clean static graphics, and who knows how each platform works. Someone with a sharp eye for detail.

We film the raw footage and write a short brief. You turn it into finished videos and graphics in the style we already use, for three kinds of work:

* Our own channels: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, 
 and
.

* Ads for our own products, starting with our two playbooks.

* From month three, the same work for our clients, in each client’s brand.

* We d
 what to make, why, and for whom. You own how it looks, how it lands on each platform, and that every detail is right.

* This is project-based work, paid per finished piece from one rate card that covers all three. No hourly rate and no hours to log. To start: roughly 4 to 5 videos, 2 carousels and 2 blog covers a week for our channels, sent as one weekly batch, plus a batch of ads whenever we refresh the playbook campaigns.



What You Would Do

* Edit talking-head and B-roll footage into 15 to 60 second vertical videos (9:16, 1080 x 1920).

* Design static posts, carousels and ad graphics from our templates and brand guide (Canva or Figma), in every size we need.

* Cut ads from our footage: 15 to 30 seconds, several hooks on the same body, in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1. Every figure in an ad must match the source exactly, never rounded.

* Follow our house style exactly: one brand typeface, clean captions, numbers on screen, no emoji or stickers.

* Pick the best takes, cut the pauses, and keep the pacing tight without making it feel rushed.

* Check every number, name and word against the script or brief.

* Blur anything confidential that appears on a screen or in notes.

* Brand check everything before it goes out: typeface, capitals on terms like ROAS, safe zones, and no TikTok under 7 seconds.

* Deliver the weekly batch within 3 working days of receiving the footage and briefs, to our shared Drive folder, with the project files. Revisions within 24 hours.



Know The Platforms

The same video does not work the same way on five channels. We never post a TikTok under 7 seconds. Captions carry every video, because many people watch with the sound off. Nothing important sits where Instagram’s buttons cover it. We want someone who knows rules like these without being told, and spots new ones before we do.

* Keep a one-page platform sheet: length, hook timing, safe zones, text and caption style for each of the five channels. Keep it current.

* Apply it to every export.

* If a brief will not work on a platform, tell us before you edit, and suggest the fix.

* With each weekly batch: five trends or formats that fit our style, with links. Part of the per-piece rate, not extra.

That judgement is yours to use. What to make stays with us.



How We Work

* We are warm with each other and with our clients. People first, then the task.

* We read the person, not just the message.

* We want you to disagree with us, including with the founder, when you think we are wrong. Say it kindly and say it early.

* We check before we claim. If you are not sure something is right, say so.



One Firm Rule

No AI-generated images, AI voices or AI avatars, ever. Our brand is built on real footage and real design. Standard editing tools (auto-captions, noise removal, colour correction) are fine.



What You Get From Us

Raw footage, a short brief per piece (hook, key points, figures, call to action), our brand guide, templates and examples of finished work. Every piece has its own card in Trello/Google doc with the brief already filled in. You never start without one, and you never have to guess.



What We Are Looking For

* A portfolio of short-form talking-head or founder-led videos, and static social or ad designs.

* Clean, restrained work. Premium, not flashy.

* Obsessive attention to detail. A wrong figure or a typo is the kind of thing we notice, and so should you.

* Reliable turnaround and clear written English.



A bonus, not required: experience with ad creative for Meta or TikTok.



Room To Grow

We want someone for the long term, and the work grows with us.

* Month one: our own channels and our playbook ads.

* From month three, if quality and deadlines hold: client work, in each client’s brand, under our name. More pieces, same rate card.

After that: running our production board and quality checks.

Your rates are reviewed at each step. What you will not own is strategy: we or the client d
 what to make, and you make it excellent.



Hours

We work Melbourne time. Your day should overlap with ours for a few hours so we can turn feedback around quickly. No night shifts.



How We Hire

A short paid test, US$15: one 30-second video from our raw footage, exported for TikTok and for LinkedIn with two lines on what you changed and why, and one static post from our template. The strongest two or three then get a second paid test, US$40: one 20-second ad for our playbook with two different hooks, in 9:16 and 4:5, and a 3-slide carousel. We pay for all of it either way, and we will tell you how you did.

Your first month is a trial for both of us. Before you start, you sign a short contractor agreement covering confidentiality, that the work you make for us is ours, and that client work is done under our name, from a Dadek
 address.



How To Apply

Please start your message with the word “margin”, so we know you have read this.

Then answer four questions:



1. Send links to two or three short-form videos and two or three static designs you made, and tell us which tools you use. Founder or talking-head videos if you have them.

2. What is your rate in US dollars for each of these: one finished 30 to 60 second video from raw footage, one ad version cut from a finished video (new hook or new size), one 5-slide carousel, and one single static post?

3. We post the same video to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, 
 and
. Name two things you would change between them, and why.

4. Have you ever caught a mistake before it went out? What happened?



Keep it short. Good work and honest answers tell us more than a long application.

title: Appointment scheduler and lead  in the generation specialist
description:
Position Overview

EFC is hiring a results-driven Appointment Setter / Lead Generation Specialist to dial provided leads, prequalify pre-retirees, and book qualified appointments on the Senior Wealth Advisor's calendar. This starts as gig work, with a path to part-time or full-time employment based on results.





Title

Appointment Setter / Lead Generation Specialist

Company

EFC Wealth Management Firm, LLC

Location

Los Angeles, CA (5901 W Century Blvd) or remote

Engagement

Gig / contract, performance-based conversion to part-time or full-time

Reports to

Founder & Senior Wealth Advisor

About EFC Wealth Management

EFC Wealth Management Firm, LLC is a California Registered Investment Advisor in Los Angeles, serving clients since 2003. We specialize in retirement planning for pre-retirees with substantial assets, guided by our Code 2 Retirement™ framework. Our founder has nearly 30 years in financial services and is the author of The Retirement Game.

Key Responsibilities

• Make high-volume outbound calls to leads supplied by EFC's marketing sources (seminars, workshops, digital campaigns, referrals).

• Prequalify each lead against EFC criteria: age, retirement timeline, investable assets, and interest in planning.

• Book qualified appointments directly on the Senior Wealth Advisor's calendar and send confirmations.

• Confirm upcoming appointments and reschedule no-shows to protect advisor time.

• Log every call, outcome, and note accurately in EFC's CRM.

• Report daily and weekly activity: dials, contacts, appointments set, appointments kept.

• Follow all Do Not Call, TCPA, and firm compliance scripts; never give investment, tax, or insurance advice.

Target Client Profile

You will be speaking with pre-retirees and retirees, typically age 57 and older, who are planning for or approaching retirement. Success requires patience, respect, and the ability to build trust quickly with an older, financially cautious audience.

• Age 57+, within roughly 10 years of retirement or recently retired

• Holding 401(k), IRA, pension, or other retirement savings

• Concerned about retirement income, taxes, Social Security timing, or market risk

Required Qualifications

• Proven lead generation experience, including working purchased, event, and digital lead lists

• Proven track record in appointment setting and phone sales, with numbers you can share (dials per day, set rate, show rate)

• Fluent, professional spoken English; clear and easily understood on the phone

• Comfortable making 100+ outbound dials per day and handling objections with confidence

• Experience scheduling directly onto an advisor's or closer's calendar

• Working knowledge of CRM and dialer software

• Reliable phone, computer, and high-speed internet (if remote)

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in insurance, annuities, or financial services

• Experience setting appointments for financial advisors, especially for retirement or seminar-based practices

• Active California Life & Health insurance license, or willingness to obtain one

• Understanding of retirement topics: 401(k) rollovers, IRAs, Social Security, Medicare

Performance Expectations and Path to Employment

This role is earned on results: hit the targets during the gig period and you are offered a part-time or full-time position.

Stage

Length

What we measure

Gig / trial

First 30–60 days

Dials, contacts, qualified appointments set, show rate

Part-time offer

After consistent targets

Appointments kept per week, CRM accuracy, reliability

Full-time offer

Sustained results

Appointment-to-client conversion, consistency

Open question: weekly targets (e.g., qualified appointments set and kept) to be set by EFC before posting.

title: Job Title: Operations & Systems Manager
description:
Job Title: Operations & Systems Manager

Salary: ₱30,000 – ₱45,000 / month



Employment Type: Full-time



Location: Remote (Philippine Standard Time working hours)



About the Role

We are looking for an Operations & Systems Manager to own day-to-day execution across people, processes, systems, and technology.



In this role, you will be the first point of contact for work-related and system problems—ensuring issues are investigated, resolved, delegated, automated, or escalated appropriately before reaching Leadership. This is a multi-hat position for an operations-minded problem solver who knows how to connect the pieces between project management, CRMs, automations, and team execution to keep the entire system running smoothly.



What Success Looks Like

Problems are identified, investigated, and solved before reaching Leadership. You understand operational and technical blockers, determine the required actions, assign the right team members, and follow tasks through to resolution.



Key Responsibilities

* Operations Management: Keep projects, deliverables, and weekly priorities moving smoothly across Sales, Marketing,    Operations, and IT.

* Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks, simplify workflows, refine SOPs, and eliminate unnecessary manual work.

* Systems Management: Oversee how CRM, payments, automations, communication tools, and internal systems connect and flow together.

* Technical Coordination: Translate business and operational problems into clear technical requirements and briefs for developers and automation specialists.

* Team Management: Run 1:1 meetings, track team performance, coach underperformance, and hold staff accountable to key deliverables.

* Problem Resolution: Act as the first line of defense to troubleshoot operational or technical issues before escalating to Leadership.

* SOP & Quality Control: Ensure established processes for payments, invoicing, commissions, sourcing, and onboarding are strictly followed.

* Hiring & Onboarding: Support final candidate interviews for specialist roles and manage end-to-end onboarding for new hires.



Technical & Core Requirements

*  CRM Operations: Daily working experience inside CRMs (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar)—managing contacts, pipelines, tags, custom fields, and smart lists, as well as troubleshooting data discrepancies.

* Automation Logic: Ability to read and understand workflows in GoHighLevel, Make, Zapier, or n8n (triggers, actions, filters, conditions) and identify where a flow broke using run history.

* Integration Fundamentals: Solid grasp of how platforms exchange data (webhooks, API connections, field mapping) and why records fail to sync (e.g.,
 mismatches across Shopify and CRM).

* Workflow Mapping: Proven ability to turn complex or messy processes into clear, step-by-step workflow maps to identify gaps, redundancies, and handoff failures.

* Technical Brief Writing: Ability to write clear requirement briefs for technical builders (trigger, expected outcome, test cases, owners) without requiring back-and-forth alignment calls.

* Project Management Tools: Hands-on experience building and managing task boards, deadlines, and team assignments in ClickUp or similar platforms.
